# Frozen, test-only differential oracle from 7d0e3927; never imported by production.
def translate(tree, variables, records=None, trace=None):
    """Shared compositional operation rules; no formula-specific Lean wrappers."""
    by_offset = {v["formulaOffset"]: v for v in variables}
    declaration_contexts = set()
    integer_depth = 0
    case_equalities = []

    def sequence_numeral_domain(node):
        witness = "(fun «" + node["binderName"] + "» : Nat => " + go_untraced(node["sequenceBody"]) + ")"
        return "(bookSequenceCodomain% " + witness + ")"

    def real_scalar_operand(node):
        """Use a real-valued comparison witness before elaborating arithmetic."""
        tokens = (
            [t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child)]
            if node["kind"] == "sequence"
            else expression_tokens(node)
        )
        converted, i = [], 0
        while i < len(tokens):
            token = tokens[i]
            if token["kind"] != "text":
                return None
            value = token["text"]
            if value.isdigit():
                start = token["start"]
                i += 1
                while (
                    i < len(tokens) and tokens[i].get("text", "").isdigit() and tokens[i]["start"] == start + len(value)
                ):
                    value += tokens[i]["text"]
                    i += 1
                token = dict(token, text=value, end=start + len(value))
            else:
                i += 1
            variable = by_offset.get(token["start"])
            if value.isdigit() or variable and variable.get("leanType") in {"Nat", "ℕ", "Int", "ℤ", "Real", "ℝ"}:
                converted.append(dict(token, kind="real-scalar-atom", body=token))
            elif value.isspace() or value in {"+", "-", "*", "/", "(", ")"}:
                converted.append(token)
            else:
                return None
        return sequence_node(converted)

    def comparison_operand(tokens):
        domain = tree.get("numericContext")
        if not domain or not all(t["kind"] == "text" and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9+*/()\s-]+", t["text"]) for t in tokens):
            return sequence_node(tokens)
        # Only wholly numeric scalar operands of a comparison inherit this
        # witness. Indices, exponents and arguments of other terms do not.
        typed, i = [], 0
        while i < len(tokens):
            token = tokens[i]
            if not token["text"].isdigit():
                typed.append(token)
                i += 1
                continue
            start = token["start"]
            number = token["text"]
            i += 1
            while i < len(tokens) and tokens[i]["text"].isdigit() and tokens[i]["start"] == start + len(number):
                number += tokens[i]["text"]
                i += 1
            typed.append(
                {
                    "kind": "source-numeral",
                    "start": start,
                    "end": start + len(number),
                    "numericDomain": domain,
                    "numeral": number,
                    "numericStart": start,
                    "numericEnd": start + len(number),
                }
            )
        return sequence_node(typed)

    def ennreal_comparison_operands(left, right):
        """Type comparison literals from a resolved source operand, not the observed call."""
        if not any(
            (v := by_offset.get(atom(n).get("start"), {})).get("status") == "resolved"
            and v.get("leanType") in {"ENNReal", "ℝ≥0∞"}
            for n in (left, right)
        ):
            return left, right
        result = []
        for operand in (left, right):
            literal = atom(operand)
            if literal.get("kind") == "command" and literal.get("name") == "infty":
                operand = dict(literal, kind="ennreal-top")
            elif literal.get("kind") == "text" and literal.get("text", "").isdigit():
                operand = dict(
                    literal,
                    kind="ennreal-numeral",
                    end=literal.get("end", literal["start"] + len(literal["text"])),
                    operatorStart=literal["start"],
                    operatorEnd=literal.get("end", literal["start"] + len(literal["text"])),
                )
            result.append(operand)
        return tuple(result)

    def traced(node, rule, term):
        nonlocal trace
        if trace is None:
            return term
        marker = f"md_operator_{len(trace)}"
        occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
        while marker in occupied:
            marker += "_"
        trace.append(
            {
                "marker": marker,
                "start": node["start"],
                "end": node["end"],
                "operatorStart": node.get("operatorStart", node["start"]),
                "operatorEnd": node["operatorEnd"] if "operatorEnd" in node else node["start"] + len(node["name"]) + 1,
                "rule": rule,
                "operandSpans": [
                    {"start": a["start"], "end": a.get("end", a["start"] + len(a.get("text", "")))}
                    for a in node["args"]
                ],
                "candidate": term,
            }
        )
        # Independently translate source operands in source order. Do not derive
        # expectations by splitting the generated operator application.
        saved_trace = trace
        trace = None
        try:
            expected_operands = []
            expected_implicit = []
            if "callee" in node:
                trace_callee = go(node["callee"])
            else:
                trace_callee = None
            if rule in {"application:metric", "application:distance-to-set"}:
                domain = metric_domain(node["metric"])
                projection = "toDist" if rule == "application:metric" else "toPseudoMetricSpace"
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 0,
                        "role": "metric-domain",
                        "candidate": domain,
                    },
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "role": "metric-instance",
                        "candidate": f"({go(node['metric'])}).{projection}",
                    },
                ]
            if rule == "literal:numeral":
                domain, number = node["numericDomain"]["type"], node["numeral"]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "numeral-type", "candidate": domain},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "numeral-instance",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : OfNat {domain} {number})",
                    },
                ]
            if rule == "cases:real":
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "result-type", "candidate": "ℝ"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "condition-decision",
                        "candidate": f"Classical.propDecidable ({go(node['args'][0])})",
                    },
                ]
            if rule == "type:homeomorphism":
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": i + 2,
                        "sourceOperand": i,
                        "role": "space-topology",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : TopologicalSpace ({go(operand)}))",
                    }
                    for i, operand in enumerate(node["args"])
                ]
            if rule == "type:dependent-sum":
                expected_implicit = [{"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "index-type", "candidate": "Nat"}]
            if rule == "constructor:sigma-pair":
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "tag-domain", "candidate": "Nat"},
                    {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "fiber-family", "candidate": node["sigmaFamily"]},
                ]
            if rule == "predicate:<":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": None, "target": "implicit-radius", "candidate": "«" + node["radiusName"] + "»"},
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": go(node["args"][0])},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "radius-type", "candidate": "Real"},
                    {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "radius-order", "candidate": "(inferInstance : LT Real)"},
                ]
            elif rule == "literal:numeral":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": None, "target": "numeral-value", "candidate": f"({node['numeral']} : Nat)"}
                ]
            elif rule == "set:real-upper-ray":
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": f"({go(node['args'][0])} : Real)"}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "interval-type", "candidate": "Real"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "role": "interval-order",
                        "candidate": "(inferInstance : Preorder Real)",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "binder:predicate-set":
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": go(node["args"][0])}]
                expected_implicit = [{"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "set-domain", "candidate": node["binderType"]}]
            elif rule in {"coercion:rational-real", "set:singleton", "set:embedded-rationals"}:
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": go(node["args"][0])}]
                carrier = f"(bookSourceType% ({expected_operands[0]['candidate']}))"
                implicit = {
                    "coercion:rational-real": ["Real", "(inferInstance : RatCast Real)"],
                    "set:singleton": [
                        carrier,
                        f"Set {carrier}",
                        f"(inferInstance : Singleton {carrier} (Set {carrier}))",
                    ],
                    "set:embedded-rationals": ["Real", "Rat"],
                }[rule]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": i, "role": "ambient-parameter", "candidate": value}
                    for i, value in enumerate(implicit)
                ]
            elif rule == "set:generated-union":
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": go(node["args"][0])}]
                expected_implicit = [{"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "union-domain", "candidate": node["carrier"]}]
            elif rule in {"sum:finite", "sum:infinite", "sum:tail"}:
                function = go(node["args"][-1])
                if rule == "sum:finite":
                    expected_operands = [
                        {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": f"Finset.range ({go(node['args'][0])} : ℕ)"},
                        {"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": function},
                    ]
                    implicit = ["ℕ", "ℝ", "(inferInstance : AddCommMonoid ℝ)"]
                else:
                    expected_operands = [
                        {"sourceOperand": len(node["args"]) - 1, "candidate": function},
                        {"sourceOperand": None, "candidate": "SummationFilter.unconditional ℕ"},
                    ]
                    implicit = ["ℝ", "ℕ", "(inferInstance : AddCommMonoid ℝ)", "(inferInstance : TopologicalSpace ℝ)"]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": i, "role": "summation-parameter", "candidate": value}
                    for i, value in enumerate(implicit)
                ]
            elif rule == "space:real-lp":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": None, "candidate": "(fun _ : ℕ => ℝ)"},
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": go(node["args"][0])},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "sequence-index", "candidate": "Nat"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "coordinate-normed-group",
                        "candidate": "(fun _ : ℕ => (inferInstance : NormedAddCommGroup ℝ))",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "literal:sequence-limit":
                number = node["numeral"]
                domain = sequence_numeral_domain(node)
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": f"({number} : Nat)"}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "sequence-codomain", "candidate": domain},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "limit-numeral-instance",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : OfNat ({domain}) {number})",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "literal:dimension-level":
                value = node["dimensionLevel"]
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": f"({value} : Nat)"}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "nonnegative-dimension-level-type", "candidate": "Nat"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "dimension-level-numeral",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : OfNat Nat {value})",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "literal:ennreal-numeral":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": None, "target": "numeral-value", "candidate": f"({node['text']} : Nat)"}
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "exponent-type", "candidate": "ENNReal"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "exponent-numeral",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : OfNat ENNReal {node['text']})",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "literal:ennreal-top":
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "exponent-type", "candidate": "ENNReal"},
                    {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "exponent-top", "candidate": "(inferInstance : Top ENNReal)"},
                ]
            elif rule == "power:real-integer":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": f"({go(node['args'][0])} : ℝ)"},
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": go(integer_expression(node["args"][1]))},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": i, "role": role, "candidate": value}
                    for i, role, value in [
                        (0, "power-base-type", "ℝ"),
                        (1, "power-exponent-type", "ℤ"),
                        (2, "power-result-type", "ℝ"),
                        (3, "power-instance", "(inferInstance : HPow ℝ ℤ ℝ)"),
                    ]
                ]
            elif rule == "operation:restrict":
                metric = distance_function(node["args"][0])
                function = "Function.uncurry (" + metric[0] + ")" if metric else go(node["args"][0])
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": set_operand(node["args"][1])},
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": function},
                ]
                if metric:
                    domain = f"({metric[1]}) × ({metric[1]})"
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "restriction-domain", "candidate": domain},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 1,
                            "role": "restriction-codomain",
                            "candidate": f"(fun _ : {domain} => ℝ)",
                        },
                    ]
            elif rule == "relation:metric-le":
                expected_operands = [
                    {
                        "sourceOperand": i,
                        "candidate": pointwise_distance(operand, node["pointDomain"], node["pointNames"]),
                    }
                    for i, operand in enumerate(node["args"])
                ]
                function_type = f"({node['pointDomain']}) → ({node['pointDomain']}) → ℝ"
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "pointwise-domain", "candidate": function_type},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "role": "pointwise-order",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : LE ({function_type}))",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "relation:sequence-limit":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "target": "sequence", "candidate": go(node["args"][0])},
                    {"sourceOperand": None, "target": "source-filter", "candidate": "(Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ)"},
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "target": "target-filter", "candidate": "nhds (" + go(node["args"][1]) + ")"},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "sequence-domain", "candidate": "Nat"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "role": "sequence-codomain",
                        "candidate": f"(bookSourceType% ({go(node['args'][1])}))",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "operation:composition":
                outer = go(node["args"][0])
                inner = distance_function(node["args"][1]) if node.get("metricComposition") else None
                inner = f"Function.uncurry ({inner[0]})" if inner else go(node["args"][1])
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": outer},
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": inner},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": i,
                        "role": role,
                        "candidate": f"((fun {{α β : Type _}} (_ : α → β) => {parameter}) ({function}))",
                    }
                    for i, (role, parameter, function) in enumerate(
                        [
                            ("composition-domain", "α", inner),
                            ("composition-middle", "β", inner),
                            ("composition-codomain", "β", outer),
                        ]
                    )
                ]
            elif rule in {"type:function-arrow", "binder:typed-map"}:
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "target": "forall.body", "candidate": go(node["args"][0])},
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "target": "forall.domain", "candidate": go(node["args"][1])},
                ]
            elif rule == "binder:repeated-tuple":
                expected_operands = [
                    {
                        "sourceOperand": None,
                        "target": "lambda.body",
                        "candidate": f"({repeated_tuple_term(node)}) book_tuple_index",
                    },
                    {"sourceOperand": None, "target": "lambda.domain", "candidate": "Nat"},
                ]
            elif rule == "application:subtype-argument":
                expected_operands = [
                    {
                        "sourceOperand": 0,
                        "candidate": f"(bookSubtypeArgument% ({go(node['function'])}), ({go(node['args'][0])}))",
                    }
                ]
            elif rule == "relation:membership-chain-equality":
                left, middle, ambient = node["args"]
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": membership_point(left, ambient)},
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": membership_point(middle, ambient)},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 0,
                        "sourceOperand": 2,
                        "role": "membership-ambient-type",
                        "candidate": f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({set_operand(ambient)}))",
                    }
                ]
            elif rule == "map:inclusion":
                left, right = [set_operand(a) for a in node["args"]]
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": None, "candidate": inclusion_proof(left, right)}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 0,
                        "role": "inclusion-ambient-type",
                        "candidate": f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({left}))",
                    },
                    {"argumentPosition": 1, "sourceOperand": 0, "role": "inclusion-source", "candidate": left},
                    {"argumentPosition": 2, "sourceOperand": 1, "role": "inclusion-target", "candidate": right},
                ]
            elif rule == "application:subtype-range":
                function = go(node["args"][0])
                carrier = go(node["args"][1])
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": function}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 0,
                        "role": "image-codomain",
                        "candidate": f"((fun {{α β : Type _}} (_ : α → β) => β) ({function}))",
                    },
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "sourceOperand": 1,
                        "role": "image-domain",
                        "candidate": f"Subtype ({carrier})",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "type:subspace-carrier":
                predicate = go(node["args"][0])
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": predicate}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 0,
                        "role": "subspace-ambient-type",
                        "candidate": f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({predicate}))",
                    }
                ]
            elif rule == "macro:AmbientClosure":
                domain = go(node["args"][0])
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": set_operand(node["args"][1])}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "sourceOperand": 0, "role": "closure-domain", "candidate": domain},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "role": "closure-topology",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : TopologicalSpace ({domain}))",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "macro:MetricBall":
                metric = go(node["args"][0])
                domain = f"(bookMetricDomain% ({metric}))"
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": metric_point(go(node["args"][1]), domain)},
                    {"sourceOperand": 2, "candidate": go(node["args"][2])},
                ]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "ball-domain", "candidate": domain},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "sourceOperand": 0,
                        "role": "ball-metric",
                        "candidate": f"({metric}).toPseudoMetricSpace",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "macro:MetricDiameter":
                domain = metric_domain(node["args"][0])
                metric = go(node["args"][0])
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 1, "candidate": metric_set(node["args"][1], metric)}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "diameter-domain", "candidate": f"(bookMetricDomain% ({metric}))"},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "sourceOperand": 0,
                        "role": "diameter-metric",
                        "candidate": f"({metric}).toPseudoMetricSpace",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "set:empty":
                witness = set_operand(node["ambient"])
                domain = f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({witness}))"
                container = f"Set ({domain})"
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "empty-set-type", "candidate": container},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 1,
                        "role": "empty-set-instance",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : EmptyCollection ({container}))",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "relation:decreasing-family":
                function = go(node["args"][0])
                codomain = f"((fun {{α β : Type _}} (_ : α → β) => β) ({function}))"
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": function}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "index-type", "candidate": "Nat"},
                    {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "set-type", "candidate": codomain},
                    {"argumentPosition": 2, "role": "index-order", "candidate": "(inferInstance : Preorder Nat)"},
                    {"argumentPosition": 3, "role": "set-order", "candidate": f"(inferInstance : Preorder {codomain})"},
                ]
            elif rule in {"set:indexed-intersection", "set:indexed-union"}:
                function = go(node["args"][0])
                codomain = f"((fun {{α β : Type _}} (_ : α → β) => β) ({function}))"
                instance = "InfSet" if rule == "set:indexed-intersection" else "SupSet"
                expected_operands = [{"sourceOperand": 0, "candidate": function}]
                expected_implicit = [
                    {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "set-type", "candidate": codomain},
                    {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "index-type", "candidate": node.get("indexType", "Nat")},
                    {
                        "argumentPosition": 2,
                        "role": "set-lattice",
                        "candidate": f"(inferInstance : {instance} {codomain})",
                    },
                ]
            elif rule == "binder:sequence-power":
                expected_operands = [
                    {"sourceOperand": 0, "target": "forall.body", "candidate": go(node["args"][0])},
                    {"sourceOperand": 1, "target": "forall.domain", "candidate": go(node["args"][1])},
                ]
            elif rule in {"binder:Sequence", "binder:mapsto", "binder:product", "binder:case", "binder:radius"}:
                expected_operands = [
                    {
                        "sourceOperand": 0,
                        "target": "forall.body" if rule == "binder:product" else "lambda.body",
                        "candidate": go(node["args"][0]),
                    },
                    {
                        "sourceOperand": 1 if rule == "binder:Sequence" else None,
                        "target": "forall.domain" if rule == "binder:product" else "lambda.domain",
                        "candidate": "Nat" if rule == "binder:Sequence" else node["binderType"],
                    },
                ]
            else:
                for index, operand in enumerate(node["args"]):
                    if rule in {"index:subscript", "index:superscript"} and index == 0:
                        continue  # The base is checked as the callee.
                    if rule.startswith("set:") or rule == "macro:SetDifference":
                        other = node["args"][1 - index]
                        value = (
                            membership_point(operand, other)
                            if rule == "set:in" and index == 0
                            else set_operand(operand, other)
                        )
                    else:
                        value = go(operand)
                    if rule in {"index:subscript", "index:superscript"} and "indexOrigin" in node:
                        value = shifted_index(operand, node["indexOrigin"])
                    if rule in {"application:metric", "application:distance-to-set"} and (
                        index == 0 or rule == "application:metric"
                    ):
                        value = metric_point(value, domain)
                    expected_operands.append({"sourceOperand": index, "candidate": value})
                if rule == "definition:=":
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 0,
                            "role": "defined-value-type",
                            "candidate": f"(bookSourceType% ({expected_operands[0]['candidate']}))",
                        }
                    ]
                if rule == "binder:image-set":
                    function = expected_operands[0]["candidate"]
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": i,
                            "role": "image-domain" if i == 0 else "image-codomain",
                            "candidate": f"((fun {{α β : Type _}} (_ : α → β) => {parameter}) ({function}))",
                        }
                        for i, parameter in enumerate(("α", "β"))
                    ]
                if rule == "operation:infimum":
                    source_set = expected_operands[0]["candidate"]
                    domain = f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({source_set}))"
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "infimum-domain", "candidate": domain},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 1,
                            "role": "infimum-instance",
                            "candidate": f"(inferInstance : InfSet {domain})",
                        },
                    ]
                if rule == "unary:-" and node.get("numericDomain") == "ℤ":
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "negation-domain", "candidate": "ℤ"},
                        {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "negation-instance", "candidate": "(inferInstance : Neg ℤ)"},
                    ]
                if rule == "infix:implicit-multiply":
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": i, "role": "multiplication-type", "candidate": "ℝ"} for i in range(3)
                    ] + [
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 3,
                            "role": "multiplication-instance",
                            "candidate": "(inferInstance : HMul ℝ ℝ ℝ)",
                        }
                    ]
                if rule == "set:in":
                    expected_operands.reverse()
                    source_set = expected_operands[0]["candidate"]
                    domain = f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({source_set}))"
                    container = f"Set ({domain})"
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "element-type", "candidate": domain},
                        {"argumentPosition": 1, "role": "container-type", "candidate": container},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 2,
                            "role": "membership-instance",
                            "candidate": f"(inferInstance : Membership {domain} ({container}))",
                        },
                    ]
                if rule == "set:product":
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": i,
                            "role": "left-domain" if i == 0 else "right-domain",
                            "candidate": f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({operand['candidate']}))",
                        }
                        for i, operand in enumerate(expected_operands)
                    ]
                if rule in {"set:IncludedIn", "set:cap", "set:cup", "macro:SetDifference", "set:=", "set:≠"}:
                    ambient = f"(bookSourceType% ({expected_operands[0]['candidate']}))"
                    expected_implicit = [{"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "set-type", "candidate": ambient}]
                    operation_class = {
                        "set:IncludedIn": "LE",
                        "set:cap": "Inter",
                        "set:cup": "Union",
                        "macro:SetDifference": "SDiff",
                    }.get(rule)
                    if operation_class:
                        expected_implicit.append(
                            {
                                "argumentPosition": 1,
                                "role": "set-operation-instance",
                                "candidate": f"(inferInstance : {operation_class} {ambient})",
                            }
                        )
                arithmetic_class = {
                    "infix:+": "HAdd",
                    "infix:-": "HSub",
                    "infix:*": "HMul",
                    "infix:/": "HDiv",
                    "macro:frac": "HDiv",
                }.get(rule)
                if arithmetic_class:
                    # The chapter's scalar arithmetic is homogeneous. Obtain
                    # its domain from a source operand, never the observed call.
                    source = next(
                        (
                            o["candidate"]
                            for o in expected_operands
                            if "«" in o["candidate"] or "bookTypedNumeral%" in o["candidate"]
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    if source is not None:
                        ambient = f"(bookSourceType% ({source}))"
                        expected_implicit = [
                            {"argumentPosition": i, "role": role, "candidate": ambient}
                            for i, role in enumerate(("left-type", "right-type", "result-type"))
                        ] + [
                            {
                                "argumentPosition": 3,
                                "role": "arithmetic-instance",
                                "candidate": f"(inferInstance : {arithmetic_class} {ambient} {ambient} {ambient})",
                            }
                        ]
                if rule in {"macro:ClosedInterval", "macro:OpenInterval", "macro:LeftClosedInterval"}:
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "interval-type", "candidate": "Real"},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 1,
                            "role": "interval-order",
                            "candidate": "(inferInstance : Preorder Real)",
                        },
                    ]
                if rule == "macro:Ball":
                    center = expected_operands[0]["candidate"]
                    domain = f"(bookSourceType% ({center}))"
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "ball-domain", "candidate": domain},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 1,
                            "role": "ball-metric",
                            "candidate": f"(inferInstance : PseudoMetricSpace {domain})",
                        },
                    ]
                if rule == "macro:Closure":
                    source_set = expected_operands[0]["candidate"]
                    domain = f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({source_set}))"
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "closure-domain", "candidate": domain},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 1,
                            "role": "closure-topology",
                            "candidate": f"(inferInstance : TopologicalSpace {domain})",
                        },
                    ]
                if rule == "macro:Abs" and "«" in expected_operands[0]["candidate"]:
                    domain = f"(bookSourceType% ({expected_operands[0]['candidate']}))"
                    expected_implicit = [
                        {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "absolute-value-type", "candidate": domain},
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 1,
                            "role": "absolute-value-lattice",
                            "candidate": f"(inferInstance : Lattice {domain})",
                        },
                        {
                            "argumentPosition": 2,
                            "role": "absolute-value-group",
                            "candidate": f"(inferInstance : AddGroup {domain})",
                        },
                    ]
                if rule in {"infix:=", "infix:≠", "infix:<", "infix:≤", "infix:>", "infix:≥"}:
                    # Obtain the type from a source operand in the original
                    # context, without the observed operator's expected type.
                    # Pure numeral expressions still need explicit domain evidence.
                    source = next(
                        (
                            o["candidate"]
                            for o in expected_operands
                            if "«" in o["candidate"] or "bookTypedNumeral%" in o["candidate"]
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    if source is not None:
                        ambient = f"(bookSourceType% ({source}))"
                        expected_implicit = [
                            {"argumentPosition": 0, "role": "source-operand-type", "candidate": ambient}
                        ]
                        order = {"infix:<": "LT", "infix:>": "LT", "infix:≤": "LE", "infix:≥": "LE"}.get(rule)
                        if order:
                            expected_implicit.append(
                                {
                                    "argumentPosition": 1,
                                    "role": "source-order-instance",
                                    "candidate": f"(inferInstance : {order} {ambient})",
                                }
                            )

        finally:
            trace = saved_trace
        trace[-1]["expectedOperands"] = expected_operands
        trace[-1]["expectedImplicitArguments"] = expected_implicit
        if trace_callee is not None:
            trace[-1]["expectedCallee"] = trace_callee
        for key in (
            "interpretationId",
            "consumer",
            "expectedVariable",
            "expectedConstant",
            "lowering",
            "expectedBinderName",
            "expectedBinderKind",
            "expectedBinderTypeName",
            "bindingComponents",
            "allowMultipleCalls",
            "sourceRestriction",
            "sourceAmbient",
        ):
            if key in node:
                trace[-1][key] = node[key]
        return f"(let {marker} := {term}; {marker})"

    def sequence_node(items):
        items = list(items)
        while items and items[0].get("text", "?").isspace():
            items.pop(0)
        while items and items[-1].get("text", "?").isspace():
            items.pop()
        if not items:
            raise Unsupported("Empty expression operand.")
        last = items[-1]
        return {
            "kind": "sequence",
            "items": items,
            "start": items[0]["start"],
            "end": last.get("end", last["start"] + len(last.get("text", ""))),
        }

    def infix_node(items, position, left, right):
        node = sequence_node(items)
        token = items[position]
        end = token.get("end", token["start"] + len(token.get("text", "")))
        return dict(node, operatorStart=token["start"], operatorEnd=end, args=[left, right])

    def atom(node):
        while node["kind"] == "sequence":
            items = [n for n in node["items"] if not (n["kind"] == "text" and n["text"].isspace())]
            if len(items) != 1:
                break
            node = items[0]
        if node["kind"] == "text":
            return dict(
                node, text=node["text"].strip(), start=node["start"] + len(node["text"]) - len(node["text"].lstrip())
            )
        return node

    def is_carrier(node):
        node = atom(node)
        if natural_type_family_shape(node):
            return True
        if node["kind"] == "command" and node["name"] in {"R", "QQ", "omega", "TwoPointSpace"} and not node["args"]:
            return True
        variable = by_offset.get(node.get("start"))
        if node["kind"] == "script" and node["marker"] == "_" and variable and variable["status"] == "resolved":
            # The existing carrier-as-universal-set convention also applies to
            # a registered Nat-indexed family of types. Lean checks the actual
            # fiber application; no index is substituted into a printed type.
            return re.fullmatch(r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Type(?: \S+)?", variable["leanType"]) is not None
        return (
            node["kind"] == "text"
            and len(node["text"]) == 1
            and variable is not None
            and variable["status"] == "resolved"
            and re.fullmatch(r"Type(?: \S+)?", variable["leanType"]) is not None
        )

    def is_empty_set(node):
        simple = atom(node)
        return (
            simple["kind"] == "command"
            and simple["name"] == "emptyset"
            and not simple["args"]
            and simple.get("optional") is None
        )

    def set_operand(node, ambient=None):
        nonlocal trace
        simple = atom(node)
        if is_empty_set(node):
            if ambient is None or is_empty_set(ambient):
                raise Unsupported("Empty set needs a source set operand to determine its carrier.")
            saved_trace = trace
            trace = None
            try:
                witness = set_operand(ambient)
            finally:
                trace = saved_trace
            domain = f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Set α) => α) ({witness}))"
            return traced(dict(simple, ambient=ambient), "set:empty", f"(∅ : Set ({domain}))")
        other = atom(ambient) if ambient is not None else None
        if (
            simple["kind"] == "command"
            and simple["name"] == "QQ"
            and not simple["args"]
            and other is not None
            and other["kind"] == "command"
            and other["name"] == "R"
            and not other["args"]
        ):
            return "Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)"
        carrier = is_carrier(node)
        # Inferred types may copy this application into several implicit slots.
        # Every copy must still receive its own callee and operand checks.
        value = go(dict(simple, allowMultipleCalls=True) if carrier and simple["kind"] == "script" else node)
        return f"(@Set.univ ({value}))" if carrier else value

    def is_set_expression(node):
        simple = atom(node)
        if simple["kind"] == "group":
            return is_set_expression(simple["body"])
        if simple["kind"] == "sequence":
            for family in natural_type_family_shapes(simple):
                if family["whole"] and family["marker"]["name"] in {"bigcap", "bigcup"}:
                    if "carrierOffset" in family["binder"]:
                        return is_carrier({"kind": "bound-symbol", "start": family["binder"]["carrierOffset"]})
                    variable = by_offset.get(family["binder"]["familyOffset"], {})
                    return (
                        variable.get("status") == "resolved"
                        and re.fullmatch(r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Set .+", variable.get("leanType", "")) is not None
                    )
        if simple["kind"] == "command" and simple["optional"] is None:
            if simple["name"] == "MetricBall":
                return len(simple["args"]) == 3
            return simple["name"] in {
                "SetDifference",
                "Ball",
                "Closure",
                "AmbientClosure",
                "ClosedInterval",
                "OpenInterval",
                "LeftClosedInterval",
            } and len(simple["args"]) == (1 if simple["name"] == "Closure" else 2)
        variable = by_offset.get(simple.get("start"), {})
        if simple["kind"] == "script" and simple["marker"] == "_":
            return (
                variable.get("status") == "resolved"
                and re.fullmatch(r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Set .+", variable.get("leanType", "")) is not None
            )
        return (
            simple["kind"] in {"text", "bound-symbol"}
            and variable.get("status") == "resolved"
            and variable.get("leanType", "").startswith("Set ")
            and simple.get("end", simple["start"] + len(simple.get("text", ""))) - simple["start"]
            == variable["end"] - variable["start"]
        )

    def inclusion_proof(left, right):
        return f"(show ({left}) ⊆ ({right}) from by intro z hz; aesop (config := {{ maxRuleApplications := 100 }}))"

    def metric_point(value, domain):
        # The source evaluates the ambient metric on subset points. Lean must
        # verify either identity or the canonical subtype projection; no cast
        # between unrelated point types is permitted.
        if case_equalities:
            return f"(bookEqualMetricPoint% ({domain}), ({value}), «{case_equalities[-1]}»)"
        return f"(bookMetricPoint% ({domain}), ({value}))"

    def metric_set(node, metric):
        return f"(bookMetricSet% ({metric}), ({set_operand(node)}))"

    def membership_point(point, set_node):
        nonlocal trace
        saved_trace = trace
        trace = None
        try:
            domain_set = set_operand(set_node)
        finally:
            trace = saved_trace
        return f"(bookSetPoint% ({domain_set}), ({go(point)}))"

    def metric_domain(node):
        nonlocal trace
        simple = atom(node)
        variable = by_offset.get(simple.get("start"), {})
        if variable.get("status") != "resolved":
            return None
        ty = variable["leanType"]
        if simple["kind"] != "script":
            end = simple.get("end", simple["start"] + len(simple.get("text", "")))
            if end - simple["start"] != variable["end"] - variable["start"]:
                return None
            return ty.removeprefix("MetricSpace ") if ty.startswith("MetricSpace ") else None
        if simple["marker"] != "_" or not re.search(r"(?:→|->|,)\s*MetricSpace ", ty):
            return None
        # Lean obtains the fiber from the actual applied family. Do not
        # substitute a source index into a pretty-printed dependent type.
        saved_trace = trace
        trace = None
        try:
            metric = go(simple)
        finally:
            trace = saved_trace
        return f"(bookMetricDomain% ({metric}))"

    def distance_function(node, *, emit=True):
        nonlocal trace
        if not emit:
            saved_trace = trace
            trace = None
            try:
                return distance_function(node)
            finally:
                trace = saved_trace
        domain = metric_domain(node)
        if domain is not None:
            return f"(@dist _ ({go(node)}).toDist)", domain
        simple = atom(node)
        if simple["kind"] == "bound-symbol" or (
            simple["kind"] == "text" and by_offset.get(simple["start"], {}).get("symbol") == simple["text"]
        ):
            offset = simple["start"]
        elif simple["kind"] == "sequence":
            tokens = [
                t
                for child in simple["items"]
                for t in expression_tokens(child)
                if not (t["kind"] == "text" and t["text"].isspace())
            ]
            if (
                len(tokens) != 2
                or tokens[0]["kind"] != "command"
                or tokens[0]["name"] != "hat"
                or tokens[0]["args"]
                or tokens[1]["kind"] != "text"
            ):
                return None
            offset = tokens[0]["start"]
        else:
            return None
        variable = by_offset.get(offset)
        if not variable or variable["status"] != "resolved":
            return None
        ty = variable["leanType"]
        if ty.startswith("MetricSpace "):
            return f"(@dist _ ({go(node)}).toDist)", ty.removeprefix("MetricSpace ")
        pieces = [part.strip() for part in ty.split("→")]
        if len(pieces) == 3 and pieces[0] == pieces[1] and pieces[2] == "ℝ":
            return "(" + go(node) + ")", pieces[0]
        return None

    def variable_term(var, *, indexed=False):
        if "indexOrigin" in var and not indexed:
            raise Unsupported("Reindexed families require an explicit supported source index.")
        if var.get("constantDeclaration"):
            return var["constantDeclaration"]
        if var["declaration"] is not None:
            declaration_contexts.add(var["declaration"])
        name = "«" + var["leanName"] + "»"
        if var.get("projection") == "Subtype.val":
            return f"(Subtype.val {name})"
        if "indexOffset" in var:
            if var["leanType"] not in {"ℕ", "Nat"}:
                raise Unsupported("Shifted source indices require a natural-number binder.")
            return f"(({name} : Nat) + {var['indexOffset']})"
        return f"(Subtype.val {name})" if "indexLowerBound" in var else name

    def shifted_index(node, origin):
        simple = atom(node)
        variable = by_offset.get(simple.get("start"), {})
        lower = variable.get("indexLowerBound", variable.get("indexOffset"))
        if simple["kind"] == "text" and simple["text"].isdigit():
            lower = int(simple["text"])
        if lower is None or int(lower) < origin:
            raise Unsupported("Reindexed family needs a source index with the declared lower bound.")
        return f"(({go(node)}) - {origin})"

    def pointwise_distance(node, domain, names):
        function = distance_function(node)
        if function:
            args = " ".join(metric_point("«" + name + "»", function[1]) for name in names)
            value = function[0] + " " + args
        else:
            value = "(" + go(node) + " : ℝ)"
        params = " ".join(f"(«{name}» : {domain})" for name in names)
        return f"(fun {params} => {value})"

    def integer_expression(node):
        def convert(part):
            kind = part["kind"]
            if kind == "group":
                return dict(part, body=convert(part["body"]))
            if kind == "sequence":
                return dict(part, items=[convert(t) for t in part["items"]])
            if kind != "text":
                raise Unsupported("Integer exponent requires scalar integer arithmetic.")
            items = []
            for match in re.finditer(r"\d+|.", part["text"], re.DOTALL):
                value = match[0]
                token = {
                    "kind": "text",
                    "text": value,
                    "start": part["start"] + match.start(),
                    "end": part["start"] + match.end(),
                }
                if value.isdigit():
                    token["kind"] = "integer-literal"
                elif value.isalpha():
                    token["kind"] = "integer-variable"
                elif value not in "+-*()" and not value.isspace():
                    raise Unsupported("Unsupported integer-exponent arithmetic.")
                items.append(token)
            return dict(part, kind="sequence", items=items)

        return dict(node, kind="integer-expression", body=convert(node))

    def go_untraced(node):
        nonlocal trace
        saved = trace
        trace = None
        try:
            return go(node)
        finally:
            trace = saved

    def case_condition(node):
        start = len(trace) if trace is not None else 0
        value = go(node)
        if trace is not None:
            for mapping in trace[start:]:
                mapping["allowMultipleCalls"] = True
        return value

    def cases_node(node):
        tokens = [t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child)]

        def delimiter(token, name):
            return (
                token.get("name") == name
                and len(token.get("args", [])) == 1
                and atom(token["args"][0]).get("text") == "cases"
            )

        begins = [i for i, t in enumerate(tokens) if delimiter(t, "begin")]
        if not begins:
            return None
        ends = [i for i, t in enumerate(tokens) if delimiter(t, "end")]
        if len(begins) != 1 or len(ends) != 1 or ends[0] <= begins[0]:
            raise Unsupported("Cases require one unnested environment.")
        first, last = begins[0], ends[0]
        rows, current = [], []
        for token in tokens[first + 1 : last]:
            if token.get("name") == "\\":
                rows.append(current)
                current = []
            else:
                current.append(token)
        rows.append(current)
        if len(rows) != 2:
            raise Unsupported("Cases require two complementary conditions.")

        def clean(ts):
            ts = list(ts)
            while ts and (ts[-1].get("text", "?").isspace() or ts[-1].get("text") in {",", "."}):
                ts.pop()
            return sequence_node(ts)

        branches = []
        for row in rows:
            splits = [i for i, t in enumerate(row) if t.get("text") == "&"]
            if len(splits) != 1:
                raise Unsupported("Each cases row needs one value and condition.")
            split = splits[0]
            branches.append({"body": clean(row[:split]), "condition": clean(row[split + 1 :]), "separator": row[split]})
        occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record.get("binders", [])}
        for i, branch in enumerate(branches):
            name = f"book_case_{tokens[first]['start']}_{i}"
            while name in occupied:
                name += "_"
            branch.update(
                kind="case-branch",
                proofName=name,
                equality=(i == 0),
                start=branch["body"]["start"],
                end=branch["condition"]["end"],
            )
        grouped = dict(
            node,
            kind="real-cases",
            branches=branches,
            start=tokens[first]["start"],
            end=tokens[last]["end"],
            opening=tokens[first],
        )
        return dict(node, items=tokens[:first] + [grouped] + tokens[last + 1 :])

    def repeated_tuple_term(node):
        values = ", ".join(f"({go(point)})" for point in node["args"])
        return f"(bookRepeatedTuple% ({go_untraced(node['witness'])}), [{values}])"

    def go(node):
        if node.get("numericExpression"):
            tokens = [t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child)]
            return go(comparison_operand(tokens))
        if node["kind"] == "finite-index-type":
            return traced(dict(node, expectedConstant="Fin"), "type:finite-index", f"Fin ({go(node['args'][0])})")
        if node["kind"] == "rational-coercion-function":
            return "((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)"
        if node["kind"] in {"real-rational-cast", "real-singleton", "embedded-rationals"}:
            head, rule = {
                "real-rational-cast": ("Rat.cast", "coercion:rational-real"),
                "real-singleton": ("Singleton.singleton", "set:singleton"),
                "embedded-rationals": ("Set.range", "set:embedded-rationals"),
            }[node["kind"]]
            annotation = "ℝ" if node["kind"] == "real-rational-cast" else "Set ℝ"
            return traced(dict(node, expectedConstant=head), rule, f"({head} ({go(node['args'][0])}) : {annotation})")
        if node["kind"] == "sequence" and "rationalAmbient" in node:
            shapes = indexed_singleton_shapes(node)
            tokens = [
                t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child) if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
            ]
            if (
                len(shapes) != 1
                or len(tokens) != 6
                or tokens[0].get("name") != "QQ"
                or tokens[1].get("text") != "="
                or shapes[0]["indexType"] != "ℚ"
                or node["rationalAmbient"].get("type") != "Real"
            ):
                raise Unsupported("Rational ambient lowering requires the complete singleton-union equality.")
            shape = shapes[0]
            index = by_offset.get(shape["binder"]["start"], {})
            if not index.get("localBinder") or index.get("leanType") != "ℚ":
                raise Unsupported("Rational singleton union requires its lexical rational index.")
            cast = dict(
                shape["value"],
                kind="real-rational-cast",
                args=[shape["value"]],
                operatorStart=shape["value"]["start"],
                operatorEnd=shape["value"]["end"],
            )
            singleton = dict(
                shape["opening"],
                kind="real-singleton",
                args=[cast],
                bindingComponents=[dict(shape["closing"], target="singleton.close")],
            )
            components = [dict(shape[key], target="lambda.domain") for key in ("domainRelation", "domain", "subscript")]
            family = dict(
                shape["binder"],
                kind="natural-sum-family",
                args=[singleton],
                binderType="Rat",
                bodyType="Set Real",
                expectedBinderName=index["leanName"],
                expectedBinderTypeName="Rat",
                operatorStart=shape["binder"]["start"],
                operatorEnd=shape["binder"]["end"],
                bindingComponents=components,
            )
            union = dict(
                shape["marker"],
                kind="rational-singleton-union",
                args=[family],
                indexType="Rat",
                sourceAmbient=node["rationalAmbient"],
            )
            left = dict(tokens[0], kind="embedded-rationals", args=[dict(tokens[0], kind="rational-coercion-function")])
            equality = dict(
                node,
                args=[left, union],
                operatorStart=tokens[1]["start"],
                operatorEnd=tokens[1]["start"] + 1,
                expectedConstant="Eq",
            )
            return traced(equality, "set:=", f"({go(left)} = {go(union)})")
        if node["kind"] == "rational-singleton-union":
            return traced(dict(node, expectedConstant="iSup"), "set:indexed-union", f"iSup ({go(node['args'][0])})")

        if node["kind"] == "real-scalar-atom":
            return f"(({go(node['body'])}) : ℝ)"
        if "prefixPredicate" in node:
            predicate = node["prefixPredicate"]
            occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record.get("binders", [])}
            name = "book_radius"
            while name in occupied:
                name += "_"
            operator = predicate["operator"]
            comparison = dict(
                node,
                kind="radius-comparison",
                radiusName=name,
                args=[predicate["bound"]],
                operatorStart=operator["start"],
                operatorEnd=operator["start"] + 1,
                expectedConstant="LT.lt",
            )
            comparison.pop("prefixPredicate")
            term = f"(fun «{name}» : Real => {go(comparison)})"
            return traced(
                dict(
                    comparison,
                    args=[comparison],
                    binderType="Real",
                    expectedBinderName=name,
                    expectedBinderTypeName="Real",
                    expectedConstant=None,
                    lowering={"kind": "implicit-radius-predicate", **predicate["domain"]},
                ),
                "binder:radius",
                term,
            )
        if node["kind"] == "radius-comparison":
            return traced(node, "predicate:<", f"(«{node['radiusName']}» < ({go(node['args'][0])}))")
        if "numericDomain" in node:
            domain = node["numericDomain"]
            context, name = domain["target"].rsplit("/", 1)
            constant = name == "@constant"
            if (
                records is None
                or context not in records
                or (not constant and not any(b["name"] == name for b in records[context]["binders"]))
            ):
                raise Unsupported("Missing numeric-domain witness in the original Lean context.")
            if not constant:
                declaration_contexts.add(context)
            witness = f"(@{context})" if constant else f"«{name}»"
            number = node["numeral"]
            term = f"(bookTypedNumeral% ({domain['type']}), ({witness}), {number})"
            return traced(
                dict(
                    node,
                    args=[],
                    expectedConstant="OfNat.ofNat",
                    operatorStart=node["numericStart"],
                    operatorEnd=node["numericEnd"],
                    lowering={"kind": "witness-result-type", **domain},
                ),
                "literal:numeral",
                term,
            )
        if node["kind"] == "case-branch":
            name = node["proofName"]
            domain = case_condition(node["condition"])
            if node["equality"]:
                case_equalities.append(name)
            try:
                term = f"(fun «{name}» : ({domain}) => ({go(node['body'])} : ℝ))"
                branch = dict(
                    node,
                    args=[node["body"]],
                    binderType=go_untraced(node["condition"]),
                    expectedBinderName=name,
                    operatorStart=node["separator"]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=node["separator"]["start"] + 1,
                )
                return traced(branch, "binder:case", term)
            finally:
                if node["equality"]:
                    case_equalities.pop()
        if node["kind"] == "real-cases":
            first, second = node["branches"]
            cond = case_condition(first["condition"])
            term = f"(@dite ℝ ({cond}) (Classical.propDecidable _) ({go(first)}) ({go(second)}))"
            return traced(
                dict(
                    node,
                    args=[first["condition"], first, second],
                    expectedConstant="dite",
                    operatorStart=node["opening"]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=node["opening"]["end"],
                ),
                "cases:real",
                term,
            )
        if node["kind"] == "subspace-carrier":
            return traced(node, "type:subspace-carrier", f"Subtype ({go(node['args'][0])})")
        if node["kind"] == "typed-function-type":
            return traced(
                node,
                "type:function-arrow",
                f"(∀ ({node['expectedBinderName']} : {go(node['args'][1])}), {go(node['args'][0])})",
            )
        if node["kind"] == "natural-sum-family":
            body = go(node["args"][0])
            if "bodyType" in node:
                body = f"({body} : {node['bodyType']})"
            term = f"(fun «{node['expectedBinderName']}» : {node.get('binderType', 'ℕ')} => {body})"
            return traced(node, "binder:mapsto", term)
        nonlocal integer_depth
        kind = node["kind"]
        if kind == "interpreted-literal":
            if records is None or any(
                name not in records
                for name in (node["expectedConstant"], node["consumer"]["declaration"], node["consumer"]["callee"])
            ):
                raise Unsupported("Missing declaration evidence for a contextual literal")
            return traced(node, "literal:contextual-constant", node["expectedConstant"])
        if kind == "integer-expression":
            integer_depth += 1
            try:
                return go(node["body"])
            finally:
                integer_depth -= 1
        if kind == "integer-literal":
            return f"({node['text']} : ℤ)"
        if kind == "integer-variable":
            variable = by_offset.get(node["start"], {})
            if variable.get("status") != "resolved" or variable.get("leanType") not in {"ℕ", "Nat", "ℤ", "Int"}:
                raise Unsupported("Integer exponent needs an explicitly resolved Nat or Int variable.")
            value = variable_term(variable)
            return f"(Int.ofNat ({value}))" if variable["leanType"] in {"ℕ", "Nat"} else value
        if kind == "repeated-tuple":
            return traced(node, "binder:repeated-tuple", repeated_tuple_term(node))
        if kind == "sequence-limit-numeral":
            domain = sequence_numeral_domain(node)
            return traced(node, "literal:sequence-limit", f"({node['numeral']} : {domain})")
        if kind == "convergence-sequence":
            body = f"(bookConvergencePoint% ({go_untraced(node['limit'])}), ({go(node['body'])}))"
            return "(fun «" + node["binderName"] + "» : ℕ => " + body + ")"
        if kind == "bound-symbol":
            var = by_offset[node["start"]]
            if var["status"] != "resolved":
                raise Unsupported(var["reason"])
            return variable_term(var)
        if kind == "text":
            parts = []
            skip_until = node["start"]
            for i, char in enumerate(node["text"]):
                if node["start"] + i < skip_until:
                    continue
                if char.isalpha():
                    var = by_offset[node["start"] + i]
                    if var["status"] != "resolved":
                        raise Unsupported(var["reason"])
                    parts.append(variable_term(var))
                    skip_until = node["start"] + i + var["end"] - var["start"]
                elif char == ":":
                    raise Unsupported("Application or local-definition grammar is not registered.")
                elif char == ",":
                    raise Unsupported("Comma syntax needs a reviewed tuple, application or list rule.")
                elif char in "0123456789 .+-*/=<>()":
                    parts.append(char)
                elif char.isspace():
                    parts.append(" ")
                else:
                    raise Unsupported("Unsupported text operator: " + repr(char))
            return "".join(parts)
        if kind == "sequence":
            membership_tokens = [
                t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child) if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
            ]
            if (
                len(membership_tokens) == 3
                and all(
                    t.get("kind") == "command"
                    and t.get("name") == name
                    and not t.get("args")
                    and t.get("optional") is None
                    for t, name in ((membership_tokens[0], "{"), (membership_tokens[2], "}"))
                )
                and membership_tokens[1].get("kind") == "text"
                and len(membership_tokens[1].get("text", "")) == 1
                and membership_tokens[1]["text"].isalpha()
            ):
                opening, point, closing = membership_tokens
                variable = by_offset.get(point["start"], {})
                if variable.get("status") != "resolved":
                    raise Unsupported("Singleton requires a resolved source point.")
                value = go(point)
                carrier = f"(bookSourceType% ({go_untraced(point)}))"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[point],
                        expectedConstant="Singleton.singleton",
                        operatorStart=opening["start"],
                        operatorEnd=opening["end"],
                        bindingComponents=[dict(closing, target="singleton.close")],
                    ),
                    "set:singleton",
                    f"(Singleton.singleton ({value}) : Set {carrier})",
                )
            if (
                len(membership_tokens) == 5
                and membership_tokens[1].get("text") == ","
                and membership_tokens[3].get("name") == "in"
                and not membership_tokens[3].get("args")
                and membership_tokens[3].get("optional") is None
                and all(
                    t.get("kind") == "text" and len(t.get("text", "")) == 1 and t["text"].isalpha()
                    for t in membership_tokens[::2][:2]
                )
            ):
                first, comma, second, relation, domain = membership_tokens
                if not is_carrier(domain) and not is_set_expression(domain):
                    raise Unsupported("Shared membership requires a resolved carrier or set domain.")
                clauses = [
                    dict(
                        node,
                        kind="shared-membership",
                        args=[point, domain],
                        start=point["start"],
                        operatorStart=relation["start"],
                        operatorEnd=relation["end"],
                        lowering={"kind": "shared-membership-domain", "member": index},
                    )
                    for index, point in enumerate((first, second))
                ]
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=clauses,
                        expectedConstant="And",
                        operatorStart=comma["start"],
                        operatorEnd=comma["start"] + 1,
                    ),
                    "logic:and",
                    f"And ({go(clauses[0])}) ({go(clauses[1])})",
                )
            conjunction = conjunction_shape(node)
            if conjunction:
                clauses = [dict(c, kind="logical-clause", body=c) for c in conjunction["clauses"]]
                marker = conjunction["operator"]
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=clauses,
                        expectedConstant="And",
                        operatorStart=marker["start"],
                        operatorEnd=marker["end"],
                    ),
                    "logic:and",
                    f"And ({go(clauses[0])}) ({go(clauses[1])})",
                )
            finite_tokens = [
                t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child) if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
            ]
            if (
                len(finite_tokens) == 5
                and [t.get("name") for t in finite_tokens[1::2]] == ["supseteq", "supseteq"]
                and finite_tokens[4].get("name") == "cdots"
            ):
                first, second = finite_tokens[0], finite_tokens[2]
                if not all(t.get("kind") == "script" and t.get("marker") == "_" for t in (first, second)):
                    raise Unsupported("Decreasing chain requires indexed endpoints.")
                endpoints = [atom(t["argument"]) for t in (first, second)]
                if not all(t["kind"] == "text" and t["text"].isdigit() for t in endpoints):
                    raise Unsupported("Decreasing chain requires consecutive literal indices.")
                start, following = (int(t["text"]) for t in endpoints)
                left = by_offset.get(atom(first["base"])["start"], {})
                right = by_offset.get(atom(second["base"])["start"], {})
                if (
                    following != start + 1
                    or not all(v.get("status") == "resolved" for v in (left, right))
                    or any(left.get(k) != right.get(k) for k in ("declaration", "leanName", "indexOrigin"))
                ):
                    raise Unsupported("Decreasing chain requires one family and consecutive indices.")
                if not re.fullmatch(r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Set .+", left.get("leanType", "")) or start < left.get(
                    "indexOrigin", 0
                ):
                    raise Unsupported("Decreasing chain requires a natural-indexed set family above its origin.")
                function = dict(
                    sequence_node(finite_tokens),
                    kind="natural-tail-family",
                    family=variable_term(left, indexed=True),
                    firstIndex=start,
                    origin=left.get("indexOrigin", 0),
                )
                components = [
                    {"start": t["argument"]["start"] - 1, "end": t["argument"]["start"], "role": "chain-index"}
                    for t in (first, second)
                ] + [{"start": t["start"], "end": t["end"], "role": "chain-continuation"} for t in finite_tokens[3:]]
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        sequence_node(finite_tokens),
                        args=[function],
                        expectedConstant="Antitone",
                        operatorStart=finite_tokens[1]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=finite_tokens[1]["end"],
                        bindingComponents=components,
                        lowering={
                            "kind": "decreasing-natural-tail",
                            "firstIndex": start,
                            "sourceOrigin": left.get("indexOrigin", 0),
                        },
                    ),
                    "relation:decreasing-family",
                    f"Antitone ({go(function)})",
                )
            if (
                len(finite_tokens) == 5
                and [t.get("name") for t in finite_tokens[1:4]] == ["cap", "cdots", "cap"]
                and all(not t.get("args") and t.get("optional") is None for t in finite_tokens[1:4])
                and all(
                    t.get("kind") == "script" and t.get("marker") == "_" for t in (finite_tokens[0], finite_tokens[4])
                )
            ):
                first, last = finite_tokens[0], finite_tokens[4]
                left_var = by_offset.get(atom(first["base"])["start"], {})
                right_var = by_offset.get(atom(last["base"])["start"], {})
                if not all(v.get("status") == "resolved" for v in (left_var, right_var)) or any(
                    left_var.get(k) != right_var.get(k) for k in ("declaration", "leanName", "indexOrigin")
                ):
                    raise Unsupported("Finite intersection endpoints must name the same resolved family.")
                if not re.fullmatch(r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Set .+", left_var.get("leanType", "")):
                    raise Unsupported("Finite intersection needs a natural-number-indexed set family.")
                lower = atom(first["argument"])
                upper = atom(last["argument"])
                if lower["kind"] != "text" or not lower["text"].isdigit():
                    raise Unsupported("Finite intersection needs a literal lower endpoint.")
                start = int(lower["text"])
                origin = left_var.get("indexOrigin", 0)
                upper_var = by_offset.get(upper["start"], {})
                guaranteed = (
                    int(upper["text"])
                    if upper["kind"] == "text" and upper["text"].isdigit()
                    else upper_var.get("indexOffset", upper_var.get("indexLowerBound"))
                )
                if guaranteed is None and upper_var.get("leanType") in {"ℕ", "Nat"}:
                    guaranteed = 0
                if start < origin or guaranteed is None or int(guaranteed) < start:
                    raise Unsupported("Finite intersection needs ordered endpoints above the family's index origin.")
                if upper_var and upper_var.get("leanType") not in {"ℕ", "Nat"}:
                    raise Unsupported("Finite intersection upper endpoint must be natural.")
                family = variable_term(left_var, indexed=True)
                upper_term = go(last["argument"])
                index_type = f"Fin (({upper_term}) - {start} + 1)"
                binder = f"book_finite_index_{first['start']}"
                occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
                while binder in occupied:
                    binder += "_"
                function = dict(
                    sequence_node(finite_tokens),
                    kind="finite-set-family",
                    family=family,
                    indexType=index_type,
                    binder=binder,
                    firstIndex=start,
                    origin=origin,
                )
                components = [
                    {"start": t["argument"]["start"] - 1, "end": t["argument"]["start"], "role": role}
                    for t, role in ((first, "range-start-subscript"), (last, "range-end-subscript"))
                ] + [
                    {"start": t["start"], "end": t["end"], "role": role}
                    for t, role in zip(finite_tokens[2:4], ("finite-range-ellipsis", "range-separator"))
                ]
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        sequence_node(finite_tokens),
                        args=[function],
                        expectedConstant="iInf",
                        indexType=index_type,
                        operatorStart=finite_tokens[1]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=finite_tokens[1]["end"],
                        bindingComponents=components,
                        lowering={
                            "kind": "finite-natural-interval",
                            "firstIndex": start,
                            "lastIndex": upper_term,
                            "sourceOrigin": origin,
                            "family": left_var["leanName"],
                        },
                    ),
                    "set:indexed-intersection",
                    f"iInf ({go(function)})",
                )
            declaration_tokens = [
                t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child) if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
            ]
            if (
                len(declaration_tokens) == 5
                and declaration_tokens[1].get("text") == ":"
