                and declaration_tokens[3].get("name") == "to"
                and not declaration_tokens[3].get("args")
                and declaration_tokens[3].get("optional") is None
            ):
                function, colon, domain, arrow, codomain = declaration_tokens
                if not is_carrier(domain) or not is_carrier(codomain):
                    raise Unsupported("Function declaration requires resolved domain and codomain carriers.")
                function_type = dict(
                    node,
                    kind="typed-function-type",
                    args=[codomain, domain],
                    expectedBinderName=f"book_arrow_input_{arrow['start']}",
                    expectedBinderKind="forall",
                    operatorStart=arrow["start"],
                    operatorEnd=arrow["end"],
                )
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[function_type, function],
                        expectedConstant="bookHasType",
                        operatorStart=colon["start"],
                        operatorEnd=colon["start"] + 1,
                    ),
                    "declaration:function-type",
                    f"bookHasType ({go(function_type)}) ({go(function)})",
                )
            signature = typed_map_shape(node) if node is tree else None
            if signature:
                point = by_offset[signature["point"]["start"]]
                if not point.get("localBinder") or point["status"] != "resolved":
                    raise Unsupported("Typed map input needs a resolved source domain.")
                declaration_contexts.add(point["binderContext"])
                domain = dict(
                    sequence_node([signature["domain"]]),
                    kind="subspace-carrier",
                    args=[signature["domain"]],
                    expectedConstant="Subtype",
                    operatorStart=signature["domain"]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=signature["domain"]["start"] + 1,
                )
                codomain = sequence_node(signature["codomain"])
                arrow = signature["arrow"]
                function_type = dict(
                    node,
                    kind="typed-function-type",
                    expectedBinderName=f"book_arrow_input_{arrow['start']}",
                    args=[codomain, domain],
                    operatorStart=arrow["start"],
                    operatorEnd=arrow["end"],
                    expectedBinderKind="forall",
                )
                colon = signature["colon"]
                typed = traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[function_type, signature["function"]],
                        expectedConstant="bookHasType",
                        operatorStart=colon["start"],
                        operatorEnd=colon["start"] + 1,
                    ),
                    "declaration:function-type",
                    f"bookHasType ({go(function_type)}) ({go(signature['function'])})",
                )
                equation = sequence_node(signature["equation"])
                quantified = traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[equation, domain],
                        expectedBinderKind="forall",
                        expectedBinderName=point["leanName"],
                        operatorStart=signature["point"]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=signature["point"]["start"] + 1,
                    ),
                    "binder:typed-map",
                    f"(∀ «{point['leanName']}» : {go_untraced(domain)}, {go(equation)})",
                )
                return f"({typed} ∧ {quantified})"
            grouped = cases_node(node)
            if grouped:
                return go(grouped)
            set_family = next(
                (
                    s
                    for s in natural_type_family_shapes(node)
                    if s["whole"] and s["marker"]["name"] in {"bigcap", "bigcup"}
                ),
                None,
            )
            if set_family:
                index = by_offset.get(set_family["index"]["start"], {})
                if index.get("status") != "resolved" or not index.get("localBinder") or index.get("leanType") != "ℕ":
                    raise Unsupported("Indexed set operation requires a registered Nat-indexed set family.")
                marker = set_family["marker"]
                node = dict(node, start=marker["start"], end=set_family["end"])
                if "carrierOffset" in set_family["binder"]:
                    carrier = variable_term(by_offset[set_family["binder"]["carrierOffset"]])
                else:
                    source_family = variable_term(by_offset[set_family["binder"]["familyOffset"]], indexed=True)
                    carrier = f"((fun {{α : Type _}} (_ : Nat → Set α) => α) ({source_family}))"
                lower_bound = set_family["binder"].get("lowerBound")
                index_type = f"{{n : Nat // {lower_bound} ≤ n}}" if lower_bound is not None else "Nat"
                family = dict(
                    node,
                    kind="natural-sum-family",
                    args=[set_family["family"]],
                    binderType=index_type,
                    bodyType=f"Set ({carrier})",
                    expectedBinderName=index["leanName"],
                    **({"expectedBinderTypeName": "Nat"} if lower_bound is None else {}),
                    operatorStart=set_family["binder"]["declarationOffset"],
                    operatorEnd=set_family["binder"]["declarationOffset"] + 1,
                    bindingComponents=set_family["binder"]["components"],
                )
                head = "iInf" if marker["name"] == "bigcap" else "iSup"
                operation = "intersection" if marker["name"] == "bigcap" else "union"
                term = f"{head} ({go(family)})"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[family],
                        expectedConstant=head,
                        indexType=index_type,
                        lowering={
                            "kind": "restricted-natural-index" if lower_bound is not None else "natural-index",
                            "lowerBound": lower_bound,
                            "projection": "Subtype.val" if lower_bound is not None else None,
                        },
                        operatorStart=marker["start"],
                        operatorEnd=marker["end"],
                    ),
                    "set:indexed-" + operation,
                    term,
                )
            product = natural_type_family_shape(node)
            if product:
                index = by_offset.get(product["index"]["start"], {})
                if index.get("status") != "resolved" or not index.get("localBinder") or index.get("leanType") != "ℕ":
                    raise Unsupported("Indexed type construction requires a registered Nat-indexed type family.")
                body = dict(product["family"], allowMultipleCalls=True)
                family_variable = by_offset.get(product["binder"]["familyOffset"], {})
                if product["marker"]["name"] == "prod" and re.fullmatch(
                    r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Set .+", family_variable.get("leanType", "")
                ):
                    body = dict(
                        body,
                        kind="subspace-carrier",
                        args=[body],
                        expectedConstant="Subtype",
                        operatorStart=body["base"]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=body["base"]["start"] + len(body["base"]["text"]),
                        lowering={"kind": "set-as-subspace-carrier"},
                    )
                if product["marker"]["name"] == "ExternalDisjointUnion":
                    family = dict(
                        node,
                        kind="natural-sum-family",
                        args=[body],
                        binderType="ℕ",
                        expectedBinderName=index["leanName"],
                        expectedBinderTypeName="Nat",
                        operatorStart=product["marker"]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=product["marker"]["end"],
                        bindingComponents=product["binder"]["components"],
                        allowMultipleCalls=True,
                    )
                    return traced(
                        dict(
                            node,
                            args=[family],
                            expectedConstant="Sigma",
                            operatorStart=product["marker"]["start"],
                            operatorEnd=product["marker"]["end"],
                        ),
                        "type:dependent-sum",
                        f"Sigma ({go(family)})",
                    )
                term = f"((«{index['leanName']}» : ℕ) → ({go(body)}))"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[body],
                        start=product["marker"]["start"],
                        end=product["family"]["end"],
                        binderType="ℕ",
                        expectedBinderName=index["leanName"],
                        expectedBinderKind="forall",
                        expectedBinderTypeName="Nat",
                        allowMultipleCalls=True,
                        operatorStart=product["marker"]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=product["marker"]["end"],
                        bindingComponents=product["binder"]["components"],
                    ),
                    "binder:product",
                    term,
                )
            mapping = mapsto_shape(node) if node is tree else None
            if mapping:
                if "point" not in mapping:
                    raise Unsupported("Mapsto requires one scalar binder with a reviewed domain.")
                variable = by_offset[mapping["point"]["start"]]
                if not variable.get("localBinder") or variable.get("status") != "resolved":
                    raise Unsupported(variable.get("reason", "Unresolved mapsto binder"))
                declaration_contexts.add(variable["binderContext"])
                body = sequence_node(mapping["body"])
                term = f"(fun «{variable['leanName']}» : {variable['leanType']} => {go(body)})"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[body],
                        binderType=variable["leanType"],
                        expectedBinderName=variable["leanName"],
                        operatorStart=mapping["arrow"]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=mapping["arrow"]["end"],
                        bindingComponents=[
                            {
                                "start": mapping["point"]["start"],
                                "end": mapping["point"]["start"] + 1,
                                "target": "lambda.binder",
                            }
                        ],
                    ),
                    "binder:mapsto",
                    term,
                )
            tokens = [t for child in node["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child)]
            depth, definitions = 0, []
            for i, token in enumerate(tokens):
                if token.get("text") == "(" or token.get("name") == "{":
                    depth += 1
                elif token.get("text") == ")" or token.get("name") == "}":
                    depth -= 1
                elif (
                    depth == 0 and token.get("text") == ":" and i + 1 < len(tokens) and tokens[i + 1].get("text") == "="
                ):
                    definitions.append(i)
            if definitions:
                if len(definitions) != 1:
                    raise Unsupported("Chained local definitions are not registered.")
                i = definitions[0]
                rhs = tokens[i + 2 :]
                if rhs and rhs[-1].get("text") in {",", "."}:
                    rhs = rhs[:-1]
                if not tokens[:i] or not rhs:
                    raise Unsupported("Local definition has an empty side.")
                left, right = sequence_node(tokens[:i]), sequence_node(rhs)
                term = f"(({go(left)}) = ({go(right)}))"
                definition = dict(
                    node, operatorStart=tokens[i]["start"], operatorEnd=tokens[i + 1]["start"] + 1, args=[left, right]
                )
                return traced(definition, "definition:=", term)
            infimum = bounded_infimum(node)
            if infimum:
                variable = by_offset[infimum["binder"]["start"]]
                if variable.get("status") != "resolved" or not variable.get("localBinder"):
                    raise Unsupported("Infimum binder has not been resolved lexically.")
                domain = sequence_node([infimum["domain"]])
                body = sequence_node(infimum["body"])
                family = dict(
                    body,
                    kind="image-lambda",
                    body=body,
                    binderName=variable["leanName"],
                    binderType=variable["leanType"],
                )
                ts = infimum["tokens"]
                image = dict(
                    sequence_node(ts[1:]),
                    kind="image-set",
                    args=[family, domain],
                    operatorStart=ts[1]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=ts[1]["end"],
                    bindingComponents=[
                        {
                            "start": infimum["binder"]["start"],
                            "end": infimum["binder"]["start"] + 1,
                            "target": "image.lambda.binder",
                        },
                        {
                            "start": infimum["relation"]["start"],
                            "end": infimum["relation"]["end"],
                            "target": "image.domain",
                        },
                    ],
                )
                term = "sInf (" + go(image) + ")"
                return traced(
                    dict(node, operatorStart=ts[0]["start"], operatorEnd=ts[0]["end"], args=[image]),
                    "operation:infimum",
                    term,
                )
            convergence = convergence_shape(node) if node is tree else None
            if convergence:
                if "binder" not in convergence:
                    raise Unsupported("Convergence needs a single reviewed sequence index.")
                binder = convergence["binder"]
                variable = by_offset[binder["declarationOffset"]]
                if not variable.get("localBinder") or variable["status"] != "resolved":
                    raise Unsupported(variable.get("reason", "Convergence index has not been resolved lexically."))
                for script in convergence["scripts"]:
                    base = expression_tokens(script["base"])[-1]
                    family = by_offset.get(base["start"], {})
                    domain = family.get("leanType", "").split("→", 1)[0].strip()
                    if family.get("status") != "resolved" or domain not in {"ℕ", "Nat"}:
                        raise Unsupported("Convergence requires natural-number-indexed families.")
                arrow = convergence["arrow"]
                if any(v["symbol"] == binder["symbol"] and v["formulaOffset"] > arrow["start"] for v in variables):
                    raise Unsupported("The limit must not contain the sequence's bound index.")
                left, right = sequence_node(convergence["left"]), sequence_node(convergence["right"])
                if right["items"][-1].get("text") in {".", ","}:
                    right = sequence_node(right["items"][:-1])
                number = atom(right)
                if number["kind"] == "text" and number["text"].isascii() and number["text"].isdigit():
                    right = dict(
                        right,
                        kind="sequence-limit-numeral",
                        args=[number],
                        numeral=number["text"],
                        sequenceBody=left,
                        binderName=variable["leanName"],
                        operatorStart=number["start"],
                        operatorEnd=number["start"] + len(number["text"]),
                        expectedConstant="OfNat.ofNat",
                        lowering={"kind": "sequence-codomain-numeral"},
                    )
                elif atom(left).get("name") == "MetricDiameter":
                    right = real_scalar_operand(right) or right
                sequence = dict(
                    left, kind="convergence-sequence", body=left, limit=right, binderName=variable["leanName"]
                )
                term = f"Filter.Tendsto ({go(sequence)}) Filter.atTop (nhds ({go(right)}))"
                traced_node = dict(
                    node,
                    operatorStart=arrow["start"],
                    operatorEnd=arrow["end"],
                    args=[sequence, right],
                    lowering={"kind": "shifted-natural-sequence-convergence", "sourceOrigin": variable["indexOffset"]}
                    if "indexOffset" in variable
                    else "natural-sequence-convergence",
                    bindingComponents=binder["components"],
                )
                return traced(traced_node, "relation:sequence-limit", term)
            ball_shapes = [s for s in ball_family_chunks(node) if "union" in s]
            restrictions = {r["generatorOffset"]: r for r in tree.get("generatorRestrictions", [])}
            ball_shapes = [s for s in ball_shapes if s["opening"]["start"] in restrictions]
            if ball_shapes:
                items = [token for child in node["items"] for token in expression_tokens(child)]
                for shape in reversed(ball_shapes):
                    first = next(i for i, t in enumerate(items) if t["start"] == shape["union"]["start"])
                    last = next(i for i, t in enumerate(items) if t["start"] == shape["closing"]["start"])
                    items[first : last + 1] = [
                        dict(
                            shape,
                            kind="generated-ball-union",
                            start=shape["union"]["start"],
                            end=shape["closing"]["end"],
                            restriction=restrictions[shape["opening"]["start"]],
                        )
                    ]
                return go(dict(node, items=items))
            set_chunks = predicate_set_chunks(node)
            if set_chunks:
                items = set_chunks[0]["tokens"][:]
                for shape in reversed(set_chunks):
                    items[shape["first"] : shape["last"]] = [
                        dict(shape, kind="predicate-set", start=shape["opening"]["start"], end=shape["closing"]["end"])
                    ]
                return go(dict(node, items=items))
            chunks = summation_chunks(node)
            if chunks:
                items = chunks[0]["tokens"][:]
                for shape in reversed(chunks):
                    items[shape["first"] : shape["last"]] = [
                        dict(shape, kind="summation", start=shape["script"]["start"], end=shape["body"]["end"])
                    ]
            else:
                items = [token for child in node["items"] for token in expression_tokens(child)]
            # Delimiter sizing has no mathematical action. Only erase a size
            # command attached to the corresponding ordinary parenthesis;
            # retain every surviving token's original source coordinates.
            sized = []
            for position, item in enumerate(items):
                if item["kind"] == "command" and item["name"] in {
                    "big",
                    "Big",
                    "bigg",
                    "Bigg",
                    "bigl",
                    "Bigl",
                    "biggl",
                    "Biggl",
                    "bigr",
                    "Bigr",
                    "biggr",
                    "Biggr",
                }:
                    following = next((t for t in items[position + 1 :] if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()), None)
                    delimiters = (
                        {"("} if item["name"].endswith("l") else ({")"} if item["name"].endswith("r") else {"(", ")"})
                    )
                    if item["args"] or following is None or following.get("text") not in delimiters:
                        raise Unsupported("Delimiter sizing is supported only for ordinary parentheses.")
                    continue
                sized.append(item)
            items = sized
            # x = y ∈ A asserts two relations, with equality in A's ambient
            # type. A subtype point is projected canonically, never identified
            # with an arbitrary point of that ambient type.
            chain_relations, chain_depth = [], 0
            for position, item in enumerate(items):
                token = item.get("text")
                if token == "(":
                    chain_depth += 1
                elif token == ")":
                    chain_depth -= 1
                elif chain_depth == 0:
                    if token in {"=", "<", ">"}:
                        chain_relations.append((position, token))
                    elif (
                        item["kind"] == "command"
                        and not item["args"]
                        and item["name"]
                        in {
                            "in",
                            "IncludedIn",
                            "le",
                            "ge",
                            "ne",
                        }
                    ):
                        chain_relations.append((position, item["name"]))
            if [relation for _, relation in chain_relations] == ["=", "in"]:
                equals, member = [position for position, _ in chain_relations]
                left = sequence_node(items[:equals])
                middle = sequence_node(items[equals + 1 : member])
                ambient = sequence_node(items[member + 1 :])
                equality_node = dict(
                    infix_node(items, equals, left, middle),
                    args=[left, middle, ambient],
                    expectedConstant="Eq",
                    lowering={"kind": "equality-membership-chain", "pointAdapter": "identity-or-Subtype.val"},
                )
                equality = traced(
                    equality_node,
                    "relation:membership-chain-equality",
                    f"(({membership_point(left, ambient)}) = ({membership_point(middle, ambient)}))",
                )
                membership = traced(
                    infix_node(items, member, middle, ambient),
                    "set:in",
                    f"(({membership_point(middle, ambient)}) ∈ ({set_operand(ambient)}))",
                )
                return f"(({equality}) ∧ ({membership}))"
            # A comparison chain asserts every adjacent relation. Split only
            # outside ordinary parentheses; macro arguments recurse separately.
            relations = {"le": "≤", "ge": "≥", "ne": "≠"}
            operands, operators, operator_positions, current, depth = [], [], [], [], 0
            for item_index, item in enumerate(items):
                token = item.get("text")
                if token == "(":
                    depth += 1
                elif token == ")":
                    depth -= 1
                operator = None
                if depth == 0:
                    if token in {"=", "<", ">"}:
                        operator = token
                    elif item["kind"] == "command" and not item["args"]:
                        operator = relations.get(item["name"])
                if operator is None:
                    current.append(item)
                else:
                    operands.append(current)
                    operators.append(operator)
                    operator_positions.append(item_index)
                    current = []
            # A final comma or period after a complete top-level relation is sentence
            # punctuation, not a tuple constructor. Interior commas still
            # require the explicit application/variable-list rules below.
            if node.get("start") == tree["start"] and node.get("end") == tree["end"] and operators and depth == 0:
                final = len(current) - 1
                while final >= 0 and current[final].get("text", "?").isspace():
                    final -= 1
                if final >= 0 and current[final].get("text") in {",", "."}:
                    current = current[:final]
            if len(operators) > 1:
                operands.append(current)
                if any(not operand for operand in operands):
                    raise Unsupported("Empty operand in comparison chain.")
                comparisons = []
                for i, operation in enumerate(operators):
                    left, right = ennreal_comparison_operands(
                        comparison_operand(operands[i]), comparison_operand(operands[i + 1])
                    )
                    term = f"(({go(left)}) {operation} ({go(right)}))"
                    comparisons.append(
                        traced(infix_node(items, operator_positions[i], left, right), "infix:" + operation, term)
                    )
                return "(" + " ∧ ".join(comparisons) + ")"
            if len(operators) == 1 and operators[0] in {"=", "≠"}:
                left, right = sequence_node(operands[0]), sequence_node(current)
                rhs = atom(right)
                if rhs["kind"] == "command" and rhs["name"] == "Tuple" and len(rhs["args"]) == 1:
                    if rhs["args"][0]["kind"] != "sequence":
                        raise Unsupported("Repeated tuple needs a displayed list followed by an ellipsis.")
                    tokens = [t for child in rhs["args"][0]["items"] for t in expression_tokens(child)]
                    groups, group = [], []
                    for token in tokens:
                        if token.get("text") == ",":
                            groups.append(sequence_node(group))
                            group = []
                        else:
                            group.append(token)
                    ending = atom(sequence_node(group))
                    if ending.get("name") != "ldots" or len(groups) < 2:
                        raise Unsupported("Repeated tuple needs at least two points followed by an ellipsis.")
                    right = dict(
                        rhs,
                        kind="repeated-tuple",
                        args=groups,
                        witness=left,
                        operatorStart=rhs["start"],
                        operatorEnd=rhs["start"] + len("\\Tuple"),
                        expectedBinderKind="lambda",
                        expectedBinderName="book_tuple_index",
                        lowering="repeated-natural-product-coordinates",
                    )
                    operation = operators[0]
                    term = f"(({go(left)}) {operation} ({go(right)}))"
                    return traced(infix_node(items, operator_positions[0], left, right), "infix:" + operation, term)
                if (
                    (is_set_expression(left) and is_carrier(right))
                    or (is_carrier(left) and is_set_expression(right))
                    or is_empty_set(left)
                    or is_empty_set(right)
                ):
                    operation = operators[0]
                    term = f"(({set_operand(left, right)}) {operation} ({set_operand(right, left)}))"
                    return traced(infix_node(items, operator_positions[0], left, right), "set:" + operation, term)
            if operators == ["≤"]:
                left = sequence_node(operands[0])
                right = sequence_node(current)
                lhs, rhs = distance_function(left, emit=False), distance_function(right, emit=False)
                if lhs or rhs:
                    domain = (lhs or rhs)[1]
                    if lhs and rhs and lhs[1] != rhs[1]:
                        lmetric = by_offset.get(atom(left)["start"], {}).get("leanType", "").startswith("MetricSpace ")
                        rmetric = by_offset.get(atom(right)["start"], {}).get("leanType", "").startswith("MetricSpace ")
                        if lmetric == rmetric:
                            raise Unsupported("Different metric domains need an explicit restriction convention.")
                        domain = rhs[1] if lmetric else lhs[1]
                    occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
                    names = []
                    for initial in ("book_point_a", "book_point_b"):
                        while initial in occupied:
                            initial += "_"
                        names.append(initial)
                    lterm = pointwise_distance(left, domain, names)
                    rterm = pointwise_distance(right, domain, names)
                    comparison = dict(
                        infix_node(items, operator_positions[0], left, right), pointDomain=domain, pointNames=names
                    )
                    return traced(comparison, "relation:metric-le", f"({lterm} ≤ {rterm})")
            if len(operators) == 1:
                left, right = ennreal_comparison_operands(sequence_node(operands[0]), sequence_node(current))
                operation = operators[0]
                real_comparison = atom(left).get("name") == "MetricDiameter"
                distance_tokens = [
                    t for child in operands[0] for t in expression_tokens(child) if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
                ]
                if (
                    operation in {"<", "≤", ">", "≥", "=", "≠"}
                    and len(distance_tokens) > 3
                    and metric_domain(distance_tokens[0]) is not None
                    and distance_tokens[1].get("text") == "("
                    and distance_tokens[-1].get("text") == ")"
                ):
                    real_comparison = True
                if real_comparison:
                    scalar = real_scalar_operand(right)
                    real_comparison = scalar is not None
                    right = scalar if scalar is not None else right
                groups, group, comma_depth = [], [], 0
                for item in operands[0]:
                    token = item.get("text")
                    if token == "(":
                        comma_depth += 1
                    elif token == ")":
                        comma_depth -= 1
                    if token == "," and comma_depth == 0:
                        groups.append(sequence_node(group))
                        group = []
                    else:
                        group.append(item)
                if groups:
                    groups.append(sequence_node(group))
                    if operation not in {"<", ">", "≤", "≥"} or any(
                        not (atom(g)["kind"] == "text" and len(atom(g)["text"]) == 1 and atom(g)["text"].isalpha())
                        for g in groups
                    ):
                        raise Unsupported("Comma comparison needs a reviewed variable-list convention.")
                    comparisons = []
                    for left in groups:
                        term = f"(({go(left)}) {operation} ({go(right)}))"
                        comparison = dict(
                            infix_node(items, operator_positions[0], left, right), lowering="variable-list-conjunction"
                        )
                        comparisons.append(traced(comparison, "infix:" + operation, term))
                    return "(" + " ∧ ".join(comparisons) + ")"
                term = f"(({go(left)}) {operation} ({go(right)}))"
                comparison = infix_node(items, operator_positions[0], left, right)
                if real_comparison:
                    comparison["lowering"] = {"kind": "real-scalar-comparison", "witness": "MetricDiameter"}
                return traced(comparison, "infix:" + operation, term)
            # A metric is a binary distance function. Compose on its values
            # through the product domain, then restore its curried interface.
            depth, compositions = 0, []
            for position, item in enumerate(items):
                if item.get("text") == "(":
                    depth += 1
                elif item.get("text") == ")":
                    depth -= 1
                elif depth == 0 and item.get("kind") == "command" and item.get("name") == "circ":
                    compositions.append(position)
            if compositions:
                if len(compositions) != 1:
                    raise Unsupported("Composition chains require explicit grouping.")
                position = compositions[0]
                if not items[:position] or not items[position + 1 :]:
                    raise Unsupported("Composition requires both functions.")
                left, right = sequence_node(items[:position]), sequence_node(items[position + 1 :])
                metric = distance_function(right)
                outer_variable = by_offset.get(atom(left).get("start"), {})
                if metric and metric_domain(right) is None and outer_variable.get("leanType") != "ℝ → ℝ":
                    # An ordinary binary function can also be the inner term
                    # of unary composition with a function-valued middle type.
                    metric = None
                inner = f"Function.uncurry ({metric[0]})" if metric else go(right)
                composition = dict(
                    infix_node(items, position, left, right),
                    expectedConstant="Function.comp",
                    metricComposition=metric is not None,
                    lowering={
                        "kind": "metric-value-composition" if metric else "function-composition",
                        "inputAdapter": "Function.uncurry" if metric else None,
                        "outputAdapter": "Function.curry" if metric else None,
                    },
                )
                result = traced(composition, "operation:composition", f"Function.comp ({go(left)}) ({inner})")
                return f"Function.curry ({result})" if metric else result
            # Set relations use an explicit carrier-to-universe convention.
            inclusions = [
                i
                for i, item in enumerate(items)
                if item["kind"] == "command" and item["name"] == "hookrightarrow" and not item["args"]
            ]
            if inclusions:
                if len(inclusions) != 1:
                    raise Unsupported("Inclusion arrows require one source and target set.")
                position = inclusions[0]
                left, right = sequence_node(items[:position]), sequence_node(items[position + 1 :])
                if not is_set_expression(left) or not is_set_expression(right):
                    raise Unsupported("Canonical inclusion requires two registered subsets of one ambient type.")
                proof = inclusion_proof(set_operand(left), set_operand(right))
                return traced(
                    dict(infix_node(items, position, left, right), expectedConstant="Set.inclusion"),
                    "map:inclusion",
                    f"Set.inclusion ({proof})",
                )
            depth, positions = 0, []
            for position, item in enumerate(items):
                if item.get("text") == "(":
                    depth += 1
                elif item.get("text") == ")":
                    depth -= 1
                elif (
                    depth == 0
                    and item["kind"] == "command"
                    and not item["args"]
                    and item["name"] in {"in", "IncludedIn", "cup", "cap", "times"}
                ):
                    positions.append((position, item["name"]))
            for level in ({"in", "IncludedIn"}, {"cup"}, {"cap"}, {"times"}):
                choices = [(i, name) for i, name in positions if name in level]
                if not choices:
                    continue
                if level == {"in", "IncludedIn"} and len(choices) != 1:
                    raise Unsupported("Chained set relations require an explicit relation rule.")
                position, operator = choices[-1]
                if node is tree and operator in {"in", "IncludedIn", "cap"} and depth == 0:
                    last = len(items) - 1
                    while last >= 0 and items[last].get("text", "?").isspace():
                        last -= 1
                    if last >= 0 and items[last].get("text") in {".", ","}:
                        items = items[:last]
                if not items[:position] or not items[position + 1 :]:
                    raise Unsupported("Missing operand in set relation.")
                left = {"kind": "sequence", "items": items[:position]}
                right = {"kind": "sequence", "items": items[position + 1 :]}
                if operator == "times":
                    if len(choices) != 1 or not (
                        (is_set_expression(left) and (is_set_expression(right) or is_carrier(right)))
                        or (is_carrier(left) and is_set_expression(right))
                    ):
                        raise Unsupported("Set product requires two registered set operands and explicit grouping.")
                    term = f"Set.prod ({set_operand(left)}) ({set_operand(right)})"
                    return traced(
                        infix_node(
                            items, position, sequence_node(items[:position]), sequence_node(items[position + 1 :])
                        ),
                        "set:product",
                        term,
                    )
                lhs = membership_point(left, right) if operator == "in" else set_operand(left, right)
                rhs = set_operand(right, left)
                symbol = {"in": "∈", "IncludedIn": "⊆", "cup": "∪", "cap": "∩"}[operator]
                term = f"(({lhs}) {symbol} ({rhs}))"
                return traced(
                    infix_node(items, position, sequence_node(items[:position]), sequence_node(items[position + 1 :])),
                    "set:" + operator,
                    term,
                )
            # Refine the shared parser's text leaves using standard arithmetic
            # precedence. Parenthesized and macro subtrees retain their scope.
            depth, arithmetic, previous = 0, [], None
            for position, item in enumerate(items):
                token = item.get("text")
                if token == "(":
                    depth += 1
                elif token == ")":
                    depth -= 1
                elif (
                    depth == 0
                    and token in {"+", "-", "*", "/"}
                    and previous is not None
                    and previous not in {"+", "-", "*", "/", "(", ","}
                ):
                    arithmetic.append((position, token))
                if not (token is not None and token.isspace()):
                    previous = token if token is not None else "operand"
            for level in ({"+", "-"}, {"*", "/"}):
                choices = [(i, op) for i, op in arithmetic if op in level]
                if choices:
                    position, operation = choices[-1]
                    left, right = sequence_node(items[:position]), sequence_node(items[position + 1 :])
                    term = f"(({go(left)}) {operation} ({go(right)}))"
                    return traced(infix_node(items, position, left, right), "infix:" + operation, term)
            if items and items[0].get("text") == "-":
                operand = sequence_node(items[1:])
                negation = dict(
                    sequence_node(items),
                    args=[operand],
                    operatorStart=items[0]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=items[0]["start"] + 1,
                    numericDomain="ℤ" if integer_depth else None,
                )
                return traced(negation, "unary:-", f"(-({go(operand)}))")
            significant = [item for item in items if not item.get("text", "?").isspace()]
            if (
                len(significant) > 2
                and numeric_power(significant[0])
                and significant[2].get("text") == "("
                and metric_domain(significant[1]) is not None
            ):
                left, right = significant[0], sequence_node(significant[1:])
                boundary = left["end"]
                multiplication = dict(
                    sequence_node(items),
                    args=[left, right],
                    operatorStart=boundary,
                    operatorEnd=boundary,
                    lowering="juxtaposition",
                )
                return traced(multiplication, "infix:implicit-multiply", f"({go(left)} * {go(right)})")
            if items and items[0].get("text") == "(" and items[-1].get("text") == ")":
                depth, closes_early = 0, False
                for position, item in enumerate(items):
                    if item.get("text") == "(":
                        depth += 1
                    elif item.get("text") == ")":
                        depth -= 1
                    if depth == 0 and position != len(items) - 1:
                        closes_early = True
                if not closes_early:
                    return "(" + go(sequence_node(items[1:-1])) + ")"
            # Decorations are source identities, not operations on a bare name.
            decorated, pos = [], 0
            while pos < len(items):
                item = items[pos]
                var = by_offset.get(item["start"])
                if var and var["symbol"].endswith("'") and item["kind"] in {"text", "command", "bound-symbol"}:
                    end_offset = item["start"] + var["end"] - var["start"]
                    end = pos + 1
                    while end < len(items) and items[end]["start"] < end_offset:
                        end += 1
                    decorated.append({"kind": "bound-symbol", "start": item["start"], "end": end_offset})
                    pos = end
                    continue
                if item["kind"] == "command" and item["name"] == "hat" and not item["args"]:
                    end = pos + 1
                    while end < len(items) and items[end].get("text", "?").isspace():
                        end += 1
                    var = by_offset.get(item["start"])
                    if end < len(items) and var and var["symbol"] == "\\hat " + items[end].get("text", ""):
                        decorated.append({"kind": "bound-symbol", "start": item["start"]})
                        pos = end + 1
                        continue
                decorated.append(item)
                pos += 1
            items = decorated
            parts, i = [], 0
            while i < len(items):
                child = items[i]
                var = by_offset.get(child["start"])
                if var and i + 1 < len(items) and items[i + 1].get("text") == "(":
                    depth, j, arguments, current = 1, i + 2, [], []
                    while j < len(items):
                        token = items[j].get("text")
                        if token == "(":
                            depth += 1
                        elif token == ")":
                            depth -= 1
                            if depth == 0:
                                arguments.append(current)
                                break
                        if token == "," and depth == 1:
                            arguments.append(current)
                            current = []
                        else:
                            current.append(items[j])
                        j += 1
                    if depth or any(not a for a in arguments):
                        raise Unsupported("Unclosed or empty function application.")
                    function = "(" + go(child) + ")"
                    ty = var.get("leanType", "")
                    domain = metric_domain(child)
                    metric_rule = "application:metric"
                    if domain is not None:
                        if len(arguments) != 2:
                            raise Unsupported("Metric evaluation requires two points or a point and a set.")
                        if is_set_expression(sequence_node(arguments[1])):
                            metric_rule = "application:distance-to-set"
                            function = f"@Metric.infDist _ ({function}).toPseudoMetricSpace"
                        else:
                            function = f"@dist _ ({function}).toDist"
                    elif "→" not in ty and "->" not in ty and not ty.startswith("∀"):
                        raise Unsupported("Application requires a function or metric binder.")
                    if domain is None and len(arguments) == 1:
                        argument = sequence_node(arguments[0])
                        target = by_offset.get(atom(argument).get("start"), {})
                        # This narrow convention applies only to f(A) where the
                        # source set A is the defining predicate of f's subtype
                        # domain. Lean rechecks that identity before using range.
                        if (
                            is_set_expression(argument)
                            and target.get("status") == "resolved"
                            and target.get("leanType", "").startswith("Set ")
                            and re.match(r"^↑" + re.escape(target["leanName"]) + r"\s*(?:→|->)", ty)
                        ):
                            image_node = dict(
                                sequence_node(items[i : j + 1]),
                                args=[child, argument],
                                expectedConstant="Set.range",
                                operatorStart=child["start"],
                                operatorEnd=child["start"] + var["end"] - var["start"],
                                lowering={"kind": "image-of-entire-subtype-domain", "domainSet": target["leanName"]},
                            )
                            parts.append(
                                traced(
                                    image_node,
                                    "application:subtype-range",
                                    f"(bookSubtypeRange% ({go(child)}), ({go(argument)}))",
                                )
                            )
                            i = j + 1
                            continue
                    args = [go({"kind": "sequence", "items": a}) for a in arguments]
                    if domain is not None:
                        args[0] = metric_point(args[0], domain)
                        if metric_rule == "application:metric":
                            args[1] = metric_point(args[1], domain)
                    application = "(" + function + " " + " ".join("(" + a + ")" for a in args) + ")"
                    application_node = dict(
                        sequence_node(items[i : j + 1]),
                        operatorStart=child["start"],
                        operatorEnd=child["start"] + var["end"] - var["start"],
                        args=[sequence_node(a) for a in arguments],
                    )
                    if domain is not None:
                        application_node["metric"] = child
                        if case_equalities:
                            application_node["lowering"] = {
                                "kind": "equality-transport-between-fibers",
                                "branchProof": case_equalities[-1],
                                "operation": "Eq.mp",
                            }
                        application = traced(application_node, metric_rule, application)
                    else:
                        application_node[
                            "expectedConstant" if var.get("constantDeclaration") else "expectedVariable"
                        ] = var["leanName"]
                        if len(arguments) == 1 and ty.startswith("↑"):
                            application_node["function"] = child
                            application_node["lowering"] = {"kind": "subtype-argument-from-local-membership"}
                            argument = f"(bookSubtypeArgument% {function}, ({args[0]}))"
                            application = f"({function} {argument})"
                            application = traced(application_node, "application:subtype-argument", application)
                        else:
                            application = traced(application_node, "application:function", application)
                    parts.append(application)
                    i = j + 1
                else:
                    parts.append(go(child))
                    i += 1
            return "".join(parts).strip()
        if kind == "shared-membership":
            point, domain = node["args"]
            return traced(node, "set:in", f"(({membership_point(point, domain)}) ∈ ({set_operand(domain, point)}))")
        if kind == "logical-clause":
            local = [v for v in variables if node["start"] <= v["formulaOffset"] < node["end"]]
            term, context = translate(node["body"], local, records, trace=trace)
            if context is not None:
                declaration_contexts.add(context)
            return term
        if kind == "natural-tail-family":
            binder = f"book_tail_index_{node['start']}"
            occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
            while binder in occupied:
                binder += "_"
            return (
                f"(fun «{binder}» : Nat => ({node['family']}) («{binder}» + {node['firstIndex']} - {node['origin']}))"
            )
        if kind == "finite-set-family":
            return f"(fun «{node['binder']}» : {node['indexType']} => ({node['family']}) («{node['binder']}».val + {node['firstIndex']} - {node['origin']}))"
        if kind == "generated-ball-predicate":
            point = by_offset[node["pointDomain"][0]["start"]]
            radius = by_offset[node["radiusCondition"][0]["start"]]
            metric = go_untraced(node["traceCondition"][0]["args"][0])
            lifted = f"(bookMetricSet% ({metric}), ({go_untraced(node['traceCondition'][0]['args'][1])}))"
            bounded = f"@Bornology.IsBounded (bookMetricDomain% ({metric})) ({metric}).toPseudoMetricSpace.toBornology ({lifted})"
            positive = case_condition(sequence_node(node["radiusCondition"]))
            value = go(node["value"])
            diameter = go(sequence_node(node["traceCondition"]))
            return (
                f"(fun «{node['setName']}» : Set ({node['carrier']}) => "
                f"∃ «{point['leanName']}» : {node['carrier']}, ∃ «{radius['leanName']}» : ℝ, "
                f"∃ «{node['positiveName']}» : ({positive}), ∃ «{node['boundedName']}» : ({bounded}), "
                f"«{node['setName']}» = ({value}) ∧ ({diameter}))"
            )
        if kind == "generated-ball-union":
            point = by_offset[node["pointDomain"][0]["start"]]
            radius = by_offset[node["radiusCondition"][0]["start"]]
            if (
                point.get("binderRole") != "ball-generator-point"
                or radius.get("binderRole") != "ball-generator-radius"
                or radius.get("leanType") != "ℝ"
                or point["leanName"] == radius["leanName"]
            ):
                raise Unsupported("Generated ball family requires distinct registered point and radius binders.")
            diameter = node["traceCondition"][0]
            metric_var = by_offset.get(atom(diameter["args"][0])["start"], {})
            trace_tokens = [
                t
                for child in diameter["args"][1]["items"]
                for t in expression_tokens(child)
                if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
            ]
            subset_var = by_offset.get(trace_tokens[-1]["start"], {})
            for role, var in (("metric", metric_var), ("subset", subset_var)):
                actual = var.get("declaration", "") + "/" + var.get("leanName", "")
                if actual != node["restriction"][role]["target"]:
                    raise Unsupported("Bounded-trace premise does not match the active " + role + " binding.")
            carrier = go_untraced(node["pointDomain"][2])
            if point["leanType"] != by_offset[node["pointDomain"][2]["start"]]["leanName"]:
                raise Unsupported("Generated point has a different carrier.")
            occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
            occupied.update(v["leanName"] for v in variables if v.get("leanName"))
            names = []
            for stem in ("book_ball_set", "book_ball_positive", "book_ball_bounded"):
                name = stem
                while name in occupied:
                    name += "_"
                occupied.add(name)
                names.append(name)
            function = dict(
                node,
                kind="generated-ball-predicate",
                carrier=carrier,
                setName=names[0],
                positiveName=names[1],
                boundedName=names[2],
            )
            components = [
                {"start": t["start"], "end": t["end"], "target": role}
                for t, role in [
                    (node["pointDomain"][0], "generator.exists.point"),
                    (node["pointDomain"][1], "generator.exists.point-domain"),
                    (node["radiusCondition"][0], "generator.exists.radius"),
                    (node["colon"], "generator.conditions"),
                    (node["closing"], "generator.scope-end"),
                ]
            ] + [
                {"start": t["start"], "end": t["end"], "target": "generator.condition-separator"}
                for t in node["separators"]
            ]
            family = dict(
                node,
                kind="generated-ball-set",
                args=[function],
                binderType=f"Set ({carrier})",
                operatorStart=node["opening"]["start"],
                operatorEnd=node["opening"]["end"],
                bindingComponents=components,
                sourceRestriction=node["restriction"],
            )
            term = f"Set.sUnion ({go(family)})"
            return traced(
                dict(
                    node,
                    args=[family],
                    carrier=carrier,
                    expectedConstant="Set.sUnion",
                    operatorStart=node["union"]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=node["union"]["end"],
                    sourceRestriction=node["restriction"],
                ),
                "set:generated-union",
                term,
            )
        if kind == "generated-ball-set":
            return traced(node, "binder:predicate-set", f"Set.ofPred ({go(node['args'][0])})")
        if kind == "predicate-lambda":
            return f"(fun «{node['binderName']}» : {node['binderType']} => ({go(node['body'])} : Prop))"
        if kind == "predicate-set":
            variable = by_offset[node["binder"]["start"]]
            if not variable.get("localBinder") or variable.get("status") != "resolved":
                raise Unsupported("Set generator needs a source-owned Lean domain mapping.")
            declaration_contexts.add(variable["binderContext"])
            function = dict(
                node["body"],
                kind="predicate-lambda",
                body=node["body"],
                binderName=variable["leanName"],
                binderType=variable["leanType"],
            )
            term = f"Set.ofPred ({go(function)})"
            return traced(
                dict(
                    node,
                    args=[function],
                    binderType=variable["leanType"],
                    operatorStart=node["opening"]["start"],
                    operatorEnd=node["opening"]["end"],
                    bindingComponents=[
                        {"start": node["binder"]["start"], "end": node["binder"]["end"], "target": "set.lambda.binder"},
                        {"start": node["colon"]["start"], "end": node["colon"]["end"], "target": "set.lambda.body"},
                        *(
                            [
                                {
                                    "start": node["domainRelation"]["start"],
                                    "end": node["domainRelation"]["end"],
                                    "target": "set.lambda.domain",
                                }
                            ]
                            if "domain" in node
                            else []
                        ),
                        {
                            "start": node["closing"]["start"],
                            "end": node["closing"]["end"],
                            "target": "set.lambda.scope-end",
                        },
                    ],
                ),
                "binder:predicate-set",
                term,
            )
        if kind == "sum-lambda":
            if "tailBound" in node:
                # The fresh offset has no source spelling; the source index keeps
                # its identity as a let-bound natural number in the original body.
                offset = node["binderName"] + "_tail_offset"
                return (
                    f"(fun «{offset}» : ℕ => let «{node['binderName']}» : ℕ := "
                    f"«{offset}» + ({go(node['tailBound'])} : ℕ); ({go(node['body'])} : ℝ))"
                )
            return f"(fun «{node['binderName']}» : ℕ => ({go(node['body'])} : ℝ))"
        if kind == "summation":
            variable = by_offset[node["binder"]["start"]]
            if variable.get("status") != "resolved" or not variable.get("localBinder"):
                raise Unsupported("Sum index has no resolved lexical binder.")
            function = dict(node["body"], kind="sum-lambda", body=node["body"], binderName=variable["leanName"])
            if node["mode"] == "tail":
                function["tailBound"] = node["bound"]
            components = [
                {"start": node["binder"]["start"], "end": node["binder"]["start"] + 1, "target": "sum.lambda.binder"},
                {
                    "start": node["script"]["argument"]["start"] - 1,
                    "end": node["script"]["argument"]["start"],
                    "target": "sum.range",
                },
                {
                    "start": node["relation"]["start"],
                    "end": node["relation"].get("end", node["relation"]["start"] + 1),
                    "target": "sum.range",
                },
            ]
            if node["mode"] == "finite":
                args = [node["bound"], function]
                term = f"Finset.sum (Finset.range ({go(node['bound'])} : ℕ)) ({go(function)})"
            else:
                args = [node["bound"], function] if node["mode"] == "tail" else [function]
                term = f"tsum ({go(function)})"
            marker = node["script"]["base"]
            return traced(
                dict(
                    node,
                    args=args,
                    operatorStart=marker["start"],
                    operatorEnd=marker["end"],
                    bindingComponents=components,
                ),
                "sum:" + node["mode"],
                term,
            )
        if kind == "image-lambda":
            return f"(fun «{node['binderName']}» : {node['binderType']} => {go(node['body'])})"
        if kind == "image-set":
            term = f"Set.image ({go(node['args'][0])}) ({go(node['args'][1])})"
            return traced(node, "binder:image-set", term)
        if kind == "ennreal-numeral":
            return traced(
                dict(node, args=[], expectedConstant="OfNat.ofNat"),
                "literal:ennreal-numeral",
                f"({node['text']} : ENNReal)",
            )
        if kind == "ennreal-top":
            return traced(dict(node, args=[], expectedConstant="Top.top"), "literal:ennreal-top", "(⊤ : ENNReal)")
        if kind == "script":
            base = atom(node["base"])
            if node["marker"] == "^" and base.get("kind") == "command" and base.get("name") == "ell":
                exponent = node["argument"]
                while exponent["kind"] == "group":
                    exponent = exponent["body"]
                exponent = atom(exponent)
                if exponent.get("kind") == "command" and exponent.get("name") == "infty":
                    exponent = dict(exponent, kind="ennreal-top")
                elif exponent.get("kind") == "text" and exponent.get("text", "").isdigit():
                    exponent = dict(
                        exponent,
                        kind="ennreal-numeral",
                        operatorStart=exponent["start"],
                        operatorEnd=exponent.get("end", exponent["start"] + len(exponent["text"])),
                    )
                else:
                    variable = by_offset.get(exponent.get("start"), {})
                    if variable.get("status") != "resolved" or variable.get("leanType") not in {"ENNReal", "ℝ≥0∞"}:
                        raise Unsupported(
                            "Sequence-space exponent needs a reviewed extended-nonnegative-real interpretation."
                        )
                space = dict(
                    node,
                    args=[exponent],
                    expectedConstant="lp",
                    operatorStart=node["argument"]["start"] - 1,
                    operatorEnd=node["argument"]["start"],
                    bindingComponents=[{"start": base["start"], "end": base["end"], "target": "real-sequence-space"}],
                    lowering={"kind": "real-sequence-lp", "index": "Nat", "scalar": "Real"},
                )
                term = traced(space, "space:real-lp", f"lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℝ) ({go(exponent)})")
                return f"↥({term})"
            named = numeric_subscript_name(node)
            variable = by_offset.get(named["start"], {}) if named else {}
            if variable.get("namedSubscript"):
                if variable.get("status") != "resolved" or variable.get("symbol") != named["symbol"]:
                    raise Unsupported("Named subscript requires its own resolved source binding.")
                target = "expectedConstant" if variable.get("constantDeclaration") else "expectedVariable"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[],
                        operatorStart=node["argument"]["start"] - 1,
                        operatorEnd=node["argument"]["start"],
                        **{target: variable["leanName"]},
                    ),
                    "name:subscript",
                    variable_term(variable),
                )
            star = starred_name(node)
            if star:
                var = by_offset.get(star["start"], {})
                if var.get("status") != "resolved" or var.get("symbol") != star["symbol"]:
                    raise Unsupported("Starred names require an explicit binding for the decorated symbol.")
                target = "expectedConstant" if var.get("constantDeclaration") else "expectedVariable"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        args=[],
                        operatorStart=star["start"] + 1,
                        operatorEnd=node["end"],
                        **{target: var["leanName"]},
                    ),
                    "name:star",
                    variable_term(var),
                )
            if node["marker"] == "^" and is_carrier(node["base"]):
                exponent = node["argument"]
                while exponent["kind"] == "group":
                    exponent = exponent["body"]
                exponent = atom(exponent)
                variable = by_offset.get(exponent.get("start"), {})
                natural = (exponent.get("kind") == "text" and exponent.get("text", "").isdigit()) or (
                    variable.get("status") == "resolved" and variable.get("leanType") in {"Nat", "ℕ"}
                )
                if not natural:
                    raise Unsupported("Finite carrier power requires a natural-number dimension.")
                finite = dict(
                    exponent,
                    kind="finite-index-type",
                    args=[node["argument"]],
                    operatorStart=exponent["start"],
                    operatorEnd=exponent.get("end", exponent["start"] + len(exponent.get("text", ""))),
                )
                occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
                binder = "book_finite_index"
                while binder in occupied:
                    binder += "_"
                power = dict(
                    node,
                    args=[node["base"], finite],
                    expectedBinderKind="forall",
                    expectedBinderName=binder,
                    operatorStart=node["argument"]["start"] - 1,
                    operatorEnd=node["argument"]["start"],
                    lowering={"kind": "finite-coordinate-space", "indexConstructor": "Fin"},
                )
                return traced(power, "binder:sequence-power", f"((«{binder}» : {go(finite)}) → ({go(node['base'])}))")
            if numeric_power(node):
                exponent = integer_expression(node["argument"])
                term = f"(({go(node['base'])} : ℝ) ^ ({go(exponent)}))"
                power = dict(
                    node,
                    args=[node["base"], node["argument"]],
                    operatorStart=node["argument"]["start"] - 1,
                    operatorEnd=node["argument"]["start"],
                )
                return traced(power, "power:real-integer", term)
            base = node["base"]
            var = by_offset.get(base["start"])
            if not var or var["status"] != "resolved":
                raise Unsupported("Indexed base has no resolved family binder.")
            ty = var.get("leanType", "")
            if node["marker"] == "^" and (
                var.get("occurrenceSelector") != "superscript-base" or ty.split("→", 1)[0].strip() not in {"ℕ", "Nat"}
            ):
                raise Unsupported("Sequence superscripts need an explicit source selector and a Nat-indexed family.")
            if "→" not in ty and "->" not in ty and not ty.startswith("∀"):
                raise Unsupported("Subscript requires a function-valued family binder.")
            origin = var.get("indexOrigin")
            if origin is not None:
                if ty.split("→", 1)[0].strip() not in {"ℕ", "Nat"} or base["kind"] != "text":
                    raise Unsupported("Reindexing requires a named natural-number family.")
                function = variable_term(var, indexed=True)
                argument = shifted_index(node["argument"], origin)
            else:
                function, argument = go(base), go(node["argument"])
            term = f"(({function}) ({argument}))"
            traced_node = dict(
                node,
                operatorStart=node["argument"]["start"] - 1,
                operatorEnd=node["argument"]["start"],
                args=[base, node["argument"]],
            )
            if origin is not None:
                traced_node.update(
                    indexOrigin=origin,
                    lowering={"kind": "natural-index-origin", "sourceOrigin": origin, "targetOrigin": 0},
                )
            if base["kind"] == "script":
                traced_node["callee"] = base
            else:
                traced_node["expectedConstant" if var.get("constantDeclaration") else "expectedVariable"] = var[
                    "leanName"
                ]
            return traced(traced_node, "index:superscript" if node["marker"] == "^" else "index:subscript", term)

        if kind == "group":
            return "(" + go(node["body"]) + ")"
        if kind == "homeomorphism-type":
            return traced(
                dict(node, expectedConstant="Homeomorph"),
                "type:homeomorphism",
                f"@Homeomorph ({go(node['args'][0])}) ({go(node['args'][1])}) "
                f"(inferInstance : TopologicalSpace ({go_untraced(node['args'][0])})) "
                f"(inferInstance : TopologicalSpace ({go_untraced(node['args'][1])}))",
            )
        if kind == "binary-alphabet":
            return traced(node, "type:binary-alphabet", "Bool")
        if kind == "command":
            name, args = node["name"], node["args"]
            if node["optional"] is not None:
                raise Unsupported("Optional argument has no expression rule.")
            if name == "seqPower" and len(args) == 2:
                alphabet, index = args
                tokens = [
                    t
                    for child in alphabet.get("items", [])
                    for t in expression_tokens(child)
                    if not t.get("text", "?").isspace()
                ]
                spelling = [t.get("text", "\\" + t.get("name", "")) for t in tokens]
                if spelling == [r"\{", "0", ",", "1", r"\}"]:
                    alphabet = dict(
                        alphabet,
                        kind="binary-alphabet",
                        args=[],
                        expectedConstant="Bool",
                        operatorStart=tokens[0]["start"],
                        operatorEnd=tokens[0]["end"],
                        lowering={
                            "kind": "binary-alphabet",
                            "zero": "Bool.false",
                            "one": "Bool.true",
                            "realSequenceEmbedding": CONVENTIONS.get("realSequenceEmbedding"),
                        },
                    )
                elif not is_carrier(alphabet):
                    raise Unsupported("Sequence power needs a registered carrier or the binary alphabet {0,1}.")
                if not is_carrier(index):
                    raise Unsupported("Sequence power needs a registered index carrier.")
                occupied = {b["name"] for record in (records or {}).values() for b in record["binders"]}
                binder = "book_power_index"
                while binder in occupied:
                    binder += "_"
                power = dict(node, args=[alphabet, index], expectedBinderKind="forall", expectedBinderName=binder)
                term = f"((«{binder}» : {go(index)}) → ({go(alphabet)}))"
                return traced(power, "binder:sequence-power", term)
            if name == "restrict" and len(args) == 2:
                metric = distance_function(args[0])
                function = "Function.uncurry (" + metric[0] + ")" if metric else go(args[0])
                return traced(node, "operation:restrict", f"Set.domRestrict ({set_operand(args[1])}) ({function})")
            if name == "Sequence":
                binder = sequence_binder(node)
                if binder is None:
                    raise Unsupported("Sequence index range requires a reviewed binding rule.")
                variable = by_offset[binder["declarationOffset"]]
                if not variable.get("localBinder") or variable["status"] != "resolved":
                    raise Unsupported("Sequence binder has not been resolved lexically.")
                term = "(fun «" + variable["leanName"] + "» : ℕ => " + go(args[0]) + ")"
                traced_node = dict(
                    node,
                    expectedBinderName=variable["leanName"],
                    expectedBinderTypeName="Nat",
                    bindingComponents=binder["components"],
                )
                if binder.get("indexOffset", 0):
                    traced_node["lowering"] = {"kind": "natural-sequence-start", "sourceOrigin": binder["indexOffset"]}
                return traced(traced_node, "binder:Sequence", term)
            if name == "NonnegativeDimensionLevel" and len(args) == 1:
                level = atom(args[0])
                if level.get("kind") != "text" or not level.get("text", "").isascii() or not level["text"].isdigit():
                    raise Unsupported("A nonnegative dimension level requires a natural numeral.")
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        expectedConstant="OfNat.ofNat",
                        dimensionLevel=level["text"],
                        lowering={"kind": "nonnegative-dimension-level"},
                    ),
                    "literal:dimension-level",
                    f"({level['text']} : Nat)",
                )
            if name == "Homeomorphic" and len(args) == 2:
                space = dict(node, kind="homeomorphism-type")
                return traced(
                    dict(node, args=[space], expectedConstant="Nonempty"),
                    "relation:homeomorphic",
                    f"Nonempty ({go(space)})",
                )
            if name == "TwoPointSpace" and not args:
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        expectedConstant="Bool",
                        lowering={"kind": "binary-alphabet", "zero": "Bool.false", "one": "Bool.true"},
                    ),
                    "type:binary-alphabet",
                    "Bool",
                )
            if name in CONSTANTS and not args:
                return CONSTANTS[name]
            if name in VARIABLE_COMMANDS and not args:
                var = by_offset[node["start"]]
                if var["status"] != "resolved":
                    raise Unsupported(var["reason"])
                return variable_term(var)
            operators = {
                "le": " ≤ ",
                "ge": " ≥ ",
                "ne": " ≠ ",
                "in": " ∈ ",
                "IncludedIn": " ⊆ ",
                "cap": " ∩ ",
                "cup": " ∪ ",
            }
            if name in operators and not args:
                return operators[name]

            # In these real-line set expressions the printed carriers denote
            # their embedded subsets. Bare QQ remains the rational type.
            def command_is(arg, expected):
                while arg["kind"] == "sequence" and len(arg["items"]) == 1:
                    arg = arg["items"][0]
                return (
                    arg["kind"] == "command" and arg["name"] == expected and not arg["args"] and arg["optional"] is None
                )

            if name == "SetDifference" and len(args) == 2 and command_is(args[0], "R") and command_is(args[1], "QQ"):
                return traced(node, "macro:SetDifference", "((Set.univ : Set ℝ) \\ Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ))")
            if name == "SetDifference" and len(args) == 2:
                return traced(
                    node,
                    "macro:SetDifference",
                    f"(({set_operand(args[0], args[1])}) \\ ({set_operand(args[1], args[0])}))",
                )
            if name in {"OpenInterval", "LeftClosedInterval"} and len(args) == 2 and command_is(args[1], "infty"):
                endpoint = go(args[0])
                interval = "Ioi" if name == "OpenInterval" else "Ici"
                return traced(
                    dict(
                        node,
                        expectedConstant=f"Set.{interval}",
                        lowering={"kind": "unbounded-real-interval", "upperEndpoint": "unbounded"},
                    ),
                    "set:real-upper-ray",
                    f"Set.{interval} ({endpoint} : ℝ)",
                )
            if name == "Pair" and len(args) == 2:
                point = by_offset.get(atom(args[1]).get("start"), {})
                if point.get("status") != "resolved" or records is None:
                    raise Unsupported("Tagged Pair requires a resolved point in a dependent fiber.")
                # Recognize only a named family applied to a named index. Lean
                # checks the actual dependent application and rejects a different tag.
                fiber = re.fullmatch(r"([\w]+) ([\w]+)", point["leanType"])
                context = records.get(point["declaration"], {})
                families = [
                    b
                    for b in context.get("binders", [])
                    if fiber
                    and b["name"] == fiber[1]
                    and re.fullmatch(r"(?:ℕ|Nat)\s*(?:→|->)\s*Type(?: \S+)?", b["type"])
                ]
                if len(families) != 1:
                    raise Unsupported("Tagged Pair requires a named Nat-indexed type family.")
                family = "«" + families[0]["name"] + "»"
                return traced(
                    dict(node, expectedConstant="Sigma.mk", sigmaFamily=family),
                    "constructor:sigma-pair",
                    f"Sigma.mk (β := {family}) ({go(args[0])}) ({go(args[1])})",
                )
            if name == "MetricBall" and len(args) == 3:
                domain = metric_domain(args[0])
                if domain is None:
                    raise Unsupported("Metric ball needs a source-owned MetricSpace parameter.")
                radius = real_scalar_operand(args[2]) or args[2]
                ball = dict(node, args=[args[0], args[1], radius], lowering={"kind": "explicit-metric-ball"})
                metric = go(args[0])
                center = metric_point(go(args[1]), f"(bookMetricDomain% ({go_untraced(args[0])}))")
                return traced(
                    ball,
                    "macro:MetricBall",
                    f"(@Metric.ball ({domain}) ({metric}).toPseudoMetricSpace ({center}) ({go(radius)} : ℝ))",
                )
            if name == "MetricDiameter" and len(args) == 2:
                domain = metric_domain(args[0])
                if domain is None:
                    raise Unsupported("Metric diameter needs a source-owned MetricSpace parameter.")
                metric, subset = go(args[0]), metric_set(args[1], go_untraced(args[0]))
                return traced(
                    node, "macro:MetricDiameter", f"(@Metric.diam ({domain}) ({metric}).toPseudoMetricSpace ({subset}))"
                )
            if name == "AmbientClosure":
                if len(args) != 2 or not is_carrier(args[0]):
                    raise Unsupported("AmbientClosure requires an explicitly resolved ambient carrier.")
                return traced(
                    node,
                    "macro:AmbientClosure",
                    f"(@closure ({go(args[0])}) inferInstance ({set_operand(args[1])}))",
                )
            if name in MACROS:
                arity, operation = MACROS[name]
                if len(args) == arity:
                    return traced(node, "macro:" + name, operation([go(a) for a in args]))
            raise Unsupported("No reviewed operation rule for \\" + name)
        raise Unsupported("Unsupported syntax node: " + kind)

    term = go(tree)
    context = shared_context(declaration_contexts, records)
    if not term:
        raise Unsupported("Empty expression")
    if not declaration_contexts and re.fullmatch(r"[\s\d.+*/()=-]+", term):
        raise Unsupported("Standalone numeric expression has no reviewed ambient number type.")
    # Two adjacent identifiers/parentheses are not automatically function application.
    if re.search(r"»\s*(?:«|\()", term):
        raise Unsupported("Application or local-definition grammar is not registered.")
    return term, context
